jobDescription:
Executive Assistant to Managing Director - Operations & Project

Coordination


Location: Remote India

Type: Full-time
Salary: 50000 to 65000 per month ( for outstanding candidates can be higher than this )
Progression: Significant opportunity to develop into broader operational responsibilities as the group continues to grow


About the Company : We are a UK-based group of companies operating across:


  • Residential architecture
  • Structural engineering
  • Residential property management

Over the last few years, the group has grown to a team of more than 25 people, with most of our operational team working remotely from India.We place a strong emphasis on:


  • Clear systems and processes
  • Accountability
  • Operational efficiency
  • Automation
  • AI
  • Modern technology
  • Taking responsibility for outcomes rather than simply completing individual actions
  • Our team uses platforms including ChatGPT, Claude, Trello, TeamGantt, Fireflies, Microsoft 365 and other integrated business systems.

As the group continues to grow, we are looking for an exceptionally capable Executive Assistant to work directly with the Managing Director and take responsibility for a wide range of administrative, operational and coordination tasks.


The Role


This is not simply a diary-management Executive Assistant position. We are looking for someone who can become the Managing Director's highly capable right hand. The role combines:


  • Executive assistance
  • Business administration
  • Task ownership
  • Basic project coordination
  • Follow-up and accountability
  • AI-assisted work
  • Basic property portfolio management
  • General operational support

A major part of your job will be taking tasks away from the Managing Director and making sure they actually get completed.


You may need to coordinate several other employees in order to achieve this.For example, you may be given an objective that requires input from accounts, IT and another department.


Your responsibility is not simply to send everyone an email.Your responsibility is to coordinate the actions, follow up where necessary, identify problems and ensure the required outcome is achieved.


We are looking for someone who understands the difference between:

I sent the reminder. and The task was completed.That distinction is extremely important to us.


1. Executive Support: You will help manage the Managing Director's day-to-day business workload. This may include:


  • Managing and organizing the calendar
  • Arranging meetings
  • Preparing information before meetings
  • Following up actions after meetings
  • Drafting emails and correspondence
  • Organising documents and information
  • Researching issues
  • Keeping track of commitments
  • Managing reminders and deadlines
  • Making appointments
  • Obtaining information from other employees
  • Dealing with routine matters without unnecessary escalation
  • Filtering administrative issues before they reach the Managing Director

The objective is to reduce the number of routine matters requiring Managing Director involvement.Where something can reasonably be handled by you, we expect you to take ownership of it.


2. Task Ownership and Follow-ThroughThis is one of the most important parts of the position.The Managing Director will regularly give you tasks or outcomes to achieve.Sometimes these will have clearly defined steps.Other times you may simply be told:Can you sort this out?You should be capable of:


  • Understanding what the required outcome is
  • Working out what needs to happen
  • Identifying who needs to be involved
  • Allocating or requesting actions from colleagues
  • Setting or confirming deadlines
  • Following up outstanding work
  • Checking that information has been received
  • Resolving straightforward problems
  • Identifying when something is going off track
  • Escalating genuinely important issues
  • Confirming that the final outcome has actually been achieved

We do not want someone who considers their responsibility complete simply because they have sent an email or reminder.We want someone who takes responsibility for getting the task over the finish line.


3. Project and Team CoordinationThe role includes basic project coordination.You do not need to be a professionally trained Project Manager and we are not looking for someone focused on complex project-management methodology.However, you should be comfortable coordinating tasks between several people.For example, the Managing Director may decide that the company needs to introduce a new process.You may then need to:


  • Identify the actions required
  • Work out which employees need to be involved
  • Create a simple action plan
  • Coordinate different team members
  • Keep track of deadlines
  • Follow up outstanding tasks
  • Identify delays
  • Make sure dependencies are dealt with
  • Keep the Managing Director informed where necessary
  • Confirm that the new process has actually been implemented

You should be capable of taking something from: Objective Actions Owners Follow-Up Completion Previous experience with project coordination would therefore be useful.


4. AI and Technology Strong practical AI skills are a core requirement for this role. We believe that a modern Executive Assistant should be capable of using AI to dramatically improve their productivity. You should already use, or be highly comfortable using, tools such as ChatGPT and Claude in your normal working life. You may use AI to help with:


  • Research
  • Drafting emails
  • Summarizing meetings
  • Analyzing transcripts
  • Organizing information
  • Comparing documents
  • Preparing reports
  • Creating checklists
  • Drafting procedures
  • Structuring unclear information
  • Researching unfamiliar subjects
  • Preparing meeting notes
  • Solving administrative problems
  • Improving existing processes

You do not need to be a programmer or AI engineer. However, candidates who have little practical experience with AI and little interest in becoming highly proficient with it are unlikely to be suitable. Equally, we do not want someone who blindly copies and pastes AI-generated answers. You must be capable of:


  • Giving AI clear instructions
  • Providing appropriate context
  • Reviewing outputs critically
  • Spotting mistakes
  • Improving the result
  • Using your own judgement

AI should make you more capable it should not replace your judgement.


5. Basic Property Portfolio Management: One of the companies within the group, CEB Properties, operates a very small UK residential property portfolio of approximately six properties.Part of your role will involve handling its routine day-to-day administration.


This is not a specialist property-management position, and the portfolio is deliberately small.


The company is building clear operating systems, workflows, checklists and procedures to make these tasks straightforward to manage.

Typical responsibilities may include:


  • Responding to routine tenant communication
  • Coordinating property viewings
  • Arranging maintenance
  • Contacting contractors
  • Following up repairs
  • Coordinating check-ins and check-outs
  • Organising referencing
  • Managing routine tenancy administration
  • Keeping property records organised
  • Monitoring safety and compliance deadlines
  • Arranging periodic inspections
  • Making sure routine property tasks are completed

Previous property-management or real-estate experience would be an advantage because you will already understand some of these processes. However, it is not essential


A capable and organized person should be able to learn this part of the role quickly using the systems provided.


6. Business Administration : You will take responsibility for a variety of routine business-administration tasks across the group.This may include:

  • Insurance renewals
  • Insurance claims administration
  • Obtaining quotations
  • Managing subscriptions
  • Supplier accounts
  • Routine business registrations
  • Organising company records
  • Renewing services
  • Basic purchasing
  • Booking appointments
  • Researching suppliers or services
  • Filling in forms
  • Following up third parties
  • Organising documents
  • Maintaining records
  • Updating trackers
  • Managing routine correspondence
  • Checking that recurring administrative tasks have been completed

We need someone who does not consider ordinary administrative work beneath them. At the same time, we want you to continually look for ways to make repetitive work easier.


You should naturally ask:


Can this be simplified?

Can AI help with this?

Can this be automated?

Can we create a template?

Can we create a checklist so we don't have to rethink this next time?


7. Follow-Up and Accountability Across the Team: Because we have a team of more than 20 people, the Managing Director cannot personally follow up every outstanding action. You will help create accountability. his may involve:


  • Following up department heads
  • Following up individual team members
  • Requesting updates
  • Checking deadlines
  • Identifying overdue actions
  • Confirming whether tasks have actually been completed
  • Organising information from several people
  • Highlighting problems
  • Escalating matters when genuinely necessary

You must therefore be comfortable politely but persistently following up colleagues, including people who may be more senior than you within their own department.


We are looking for somebody who is pleasant and professional but persistent.


8. Process Improvement: You do not need to be an operations Manager. However, we want someone who naturally likes organized ways of working. As you become familiar with the business, you may help:


  • Improve checklists
  • Create templates
  • Document recurring tasks
  • Improve simple procedures
  • Organise filing systems
  • Identify unnecessary administration
  • Improve trackers
  • Identify repetitive work that could be automated
  • Use AI to improve routine processes

The Managing Director and Operations team will develop many of the larger operating systems.


Your job will often be to work effectively within those systems and help improve them through practical experience.

The Person We Are Looking For


We are looking for someone who is:


  • Extremely organised
  • Highly proactive
  • Intelligent and quick to learn
  • Dependable
  • Persistent
  • Detail-oriented
  • Comfortable working independently
  • Comfortable coordinating other employees
  • Capable of managing several tasks simultaneously
  • Strong at following work through to completion
  • Confident communicating with department heads
  • Excellent in written and spoken English
  • Technically confident
  • Comfortable learning new software
  • Already comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude
  • Capable of researching unfamiliar subjects
  • Able to use common sense and judgement
  • Solutions-focused
  • Discreet and trustworthy
  • Comfortable carrying out basic administrative work

Most importantly, you should have a strong sense of ownership.

If you are given responsibility for something, we want you to think:I am responsible for making sure this gets done.Particularly

Relevant Experience


We would be particularly interested in candidates who have previously worked as:


  • Executive Assistant
  • Executive Assistant to Founder / CEO / Managing Director
  • Senior Executive Assistant
  • Founders Office Associate
  • Business Operations Associate
  • Operations Executive
  • Business Support Executive
  • Executive Operations Associate
  • Administrative Manager

Experience involving any of the following would also be particularly valuable:


  • Project coordination
  • Property management
  • Real estate
  • Business operations
  • Working with multiple departments
  • Process improvement
  • Startup or SME environments
  • Working directly with a founder or Managing Director
  • AI and automation

You do not need experience in every area. We are more interested in intelligence, ownership, organization, judgement and ability to learn quickly than in finding somebody whose previous job description exactly matches ours.


This Role Is Probably Not Right for You If

This position is unlikely to suit you if:


  • You require detailed instructions for every task
  • You are uncomfortable making straightforward decisions
  • You dislike chasing people for outstanding actions
  • You consider a task complete simply because you sent a reminder
  • You dislike basic administrative work
  • You prefer very narrowly defined responsibilities
  • You struggle to manage several different types of work
  • You are uncomfortable learning new technology
  • You rarely use AI and have little interest in becoming proficient with it
  • You regularly escalate straightforward problems rather than trying to solve them

What Success Looks Like


Within your first six months, we would expect you to have:


  • Taken control of a substantial amount of the Managing Director's routine administration
  • Reduced unnecessary interruptions to the Managing Director
  • Created a reliable system for managing follow-ups and outstanding actions
  • Successfully coordinated multiple tasks involving different employees
  • Taken responsibility for routine administration within the small property portfolio
  • Become confident managing its approximately six properties
  • Taken responsibility for routine business administration such as insurance, suppliers and renewals
  • Become highly proficient with the company's AI tools
  • Improved the organisation of important information and records
  • Assisted with several internal projects
  • Improved or documented recurring administrative processes
  • Demonstrated that when you are given an outcome to achieve, you can take responsibility for getting it completed

Development and Progression: This role has significant scope to develop.


As you become more capable and understand the business, you may progressively take responsibility for:


  • More complex internal projects
  • Wider operational coordination
  • Property operations
  • Business processes
  • Automation initiatives
  • Junior administrative support
  • Cross-departmental initiatives

We are a growing business and are looking for someone who wants to become a highly trusted and capable member of the management support team.


Application


Shortlisted candidates will be assessed primarily on practical capability rather than CV length or impressive job titles.

We are particularly interested in evidence of:


  • Strong practical AI use
  • Exceptional organisation
  • Task ownership
  • Follow-through
  • Problem solving
  • Basic project coordination
  • Clear written communication
  • Good business judgement
  • The ability to take an objective and get it completed

descriptionFromApi:
The Opportunity

The platform is built and going to market now - the agentic roadmap ships this year. The systems you build move real money, contact real people under real compliance constraints, and run autonomously at scale. Youll work directly with the founders: no layers, no ticket factory, genuine ownership end to end. Expanding across NZ, AU, and US.

The Role

Full-stack, AI-first, real engineer underneath. You build and ship features across UI, API routes, background jobs, and database. AI coding agents (Claude Code and similar) are a core part of the daily workflow - but you must be a real engineer underneath the tooling. The AI writes a lot of the code; you own the design, the correctness, and the explanation.

What You Will Do
  • Design, build, and ship features end to end: frontend, backend, schema, tests.
  • Use AI coding agents daily to plan, implement, review, and test - and know when not to trust them.
  • Review AI-generated and human-written code critically; catch bugs, security issues, and shortcuts before they ship.
  • Explain your work clearly: walk the team through what youre building, why it works, the trade-offs you made - demo it on ship.
  • Write clear PR descriptions, docs, and async updates others can act on without a meeting.
  • Debug production issues across the stack (app, database, background jobs, third-party APIs).
Must-Haves

Technical

1-3 years professional software development experience.

Solid TypeScript and React; comfortable with Next.js (App Router) or able to ramp fast.

Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases (Postgres via Supabase).

Understanding of REST APIs, auth, async patterns (queues, webhooks, background jobs).

Testing habits: unit and integration tests without being asked.

Can open the editor and solve the problem yourself when the agent is wrong, stuck, or unavailable. Our interview includes a no-AI coding round.

AI-agent fluency

  • Hands-on daily experience with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot agent mode) - not just autocomplete.
  • Can scope a task for an agent, give it context, review its output line by line, and iterate.
  • Can tell when AI output is subtly wrong - understand why - and never merge code you dont.
Communication
  • Can explain a feature you built to an engineer, a PM, or a customer - at the right level for each.
  • Clear written English: PRs, docs, Slack updates.
  • Comfortable demoing your work and answering questions about how and why it works.
  • Interview includes presenting a feature youve built: what it does, how it works, what youd do differently.
Nice-To-Haves

Supabase (Postgres RLS migrations) Tailwind CSS shadcn/ui Zustand TanStack Query Payments / fintech domain Twilio SES VAPI Playwright / E2E testing pnpm workspaces Turborepo

Stack

Next.js 16 (App Router) React 19 TypeScript (strict, no any) Tailwind v4 Supabase (Postgres) shadcn/ui Zustand + TanStack Query Inngest Jest + Playwright Railway.

How We Work

Strict quality gates: no any, typed data access, full build and tests before merge. Async-first, light meeting load. We handle sensitive financial data and real-people communications, so we build with care - and hire people who feel the weight of that.

Location - Remote (NZ / AU / US) .

Edge AI Development

  • Deploy AI models on NVIDIA Jetson edge devices.
  • Assist in optimizing inference speed and system performance.

Software Development

  • Build utilities for AI model evaluation and deployment.

Data & Backend

  • Store and retrieve AI detection results.
  • Assist in API integration and dashboard development.

  • Participate in R&D for AI-based highway monitoring and intelligent transportation solutions.

Technical skills

  • Good programming knowledge in Python.
  • Understanding of Machine Learning and Deep Learning fundamentals.
  • Basic knowledge of OpenCV.
  • Familiarity with TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Ultralytics YOLO.
  • Understanding of object detection or image classification concepts.

  • Familiarity with Linux operating systems.

  • Software development best practices and version control.

Founding Engineer


Company: Kutlerri.ai

About Kutlerri.ai


Kutlerri.ai builds AI agents for restaurants, focused on two outcomes: increasing revenue and reducing costs.


Our first AI agent, the Catering Sales Agent, is already live with paying US restaurant customers. It helps restaurants capture catering opportunities, respond to inquiries, send quotes, follow up with prospects, and turn one-time orders into repeat accounts.


We are now building the next generation of AI agents for restaurant operations across areas such as margin recovery, prep forecasting, menu economics, and customer retention.


That's where you come in.


About the Role


We are looking for a Founding Engineer who wants to build products from the ground up.


You will work directly with the founding team and own features end-to-end, from database schema to frontend, AI agent layer, integrations, deployment, and production monitoring.


This is a hands-on role in a small team. There is no "that's not my layer." One day you may build a product screen, the next you may work on LLM orchestration, and the next you may integrate with a POS system.

You will see your work in the hands of real restaurant operators quickly.


What You Will Own


Full-Stack Product Development

  • Build product experiences that restaurant operators can understand and use easily.
  • Own features from database/schema design to frontend implementation.
  • Work across frontend, backend, APIs, and infrastructure.
  • Build and ship production-ready features quickly.

AI Agents

  • Design and build AI agents using LLMs.
  • Work on prompts, tool use, memory, guardrails, and agent workflows.
  • Build evaluation systems to measure agent quality.
  • Make practical trade-offs between latency, reliability, and cost.

Integrations

  • Build integrations with POS systems, email platforms, telephony, calendars, and other third-party APIs.
  • Handle inconsistent APIs, messy data formats, authentication, retries, and edge cases.
  • Build clean internal abstractions over external systems.

Data

  • Build pipelines that transform messy restaurant data into reliable information AI agents can reason over.
  • Work with operational and transactional data.
  • Ensure data quality and reliability because bad data leads to bad agent decisions.

Production

  • Deploy and operate what you build.
  • Monitor production systems, investigate failures, and improve reliability.
  • Debug using logs, metrics, and real production behaviour.
  • Build systems that work reliably for customers, not just in development environments.

What We're Looking For


  • At least one product, application, or project that has been used by real people.
  • Strong full-stack engineering fundamentals.
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs / Generative AI, beyond simply calling an API.
  • Understanding of prompt engineering, tool calling, agent workflows, evaluations, latency, and cost trade-offs.
  • Comfortable working across frontend, backend, AI, and infrastructure.
  • Strong debugging skills and an ability to work through ambiguous technical problems.
  • Comfortable working with third-party APIs and integrations.
  • Clear written and verbal communication.
  • Willingness to work with US customers and occasionally overlap with US evening hours.

We care more about what you've built than how long you've been working.


A strong side project counts if real people have used it.


How We Work


  • Default Driver Mode: Own outcomes without waiting to be told what to do.
  • Customer Over Everything: Operator reality beats internal assumptions.
  • Ship, Learn, Fix, Repeat: Fast iteration is the strategy.
  • Progress Beats Perfection: A live v1 teaches more than a perfect specification.
  • Zero Ego: The best argument wins.

What Success Looks Like


In your first 6 months, you should have:

  • Shipped a second AI agent into production with paying design partners.
  • Built reliable integrations that operators rarely notice because they simply work.
  • Contributed to a codebase that is easier and faster for the next engineer to build on.

Why Join Us?


  • Work directly with the founding team.
  • Own meaningful technical and architectural decisions from day one.
  • Build AI products used by real US restaurant operators.
  • No ticket queue between you and the customer.
  • Fast decisions and rapid product launches.
  • High ownership and visibility.
  • Competitive compensation for the stage.

How to Apply


We don't need a long cover letter.


Tell us about the best thing you've built and what broke when real people first used it.


Send your resume + GitHub, portfolio, live product, or project links to:

careers@kutlerri.ai

descriptionFromApi:
AI Engineer (Full Stack)- Imitate Labs


Location: Chennai (Thiruvanmiyur), On-site

Reports to: Founder & CEO (David)

Works alongside: Product Engineer

Joining: Immediate


ABOUT THE ROLE


Imitate Labs is building Aurra Sales Agent, an AI powered voice calling platform helping B2B businesses across India automate customer conversations. We serve Real Estate, Insurance, Automotive, Healthcare, EdTech, and NBFC clients.


We're looking for an AI Engineer whose primary focus is the AI layer itself choosing and evaluating the models we run on, improving how our voice agents converse, bringing down inference and infrastructure cost, and building the intelligence products we sell to clients.


This is a builder's role in a small team, so the work doesn't stop at a recommendation. You'll write the Python services that power our voice agents and AI pipelines, build and extend the Node.js backend and Next.js interfaces around them, and deploy and operate what you ship on our cloud infrastructure.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Core Focus AI, Models & Intelligence


1. Model Evaluation & Cost Optimization

- Evaluate and compare LLM, Speech to Text, Text to Speech, and voice agent options to bring down inference and infrastructure cost without hurting conversation quality.

- Benchmark providers and model tiers on latency, accuracy, and cost per minute, and make a clear call on what we should be running.

- Own our cost per call and cost per minute numbers token economics, prompt and context budgeting, caching, and understanding where the money actually goes.

- Assess self hosted open weight models against hosted APIs where the economics make sense.

- Build quick prototypes, test promising options against real call data, and take the winning one to production.

- Keep clear written notes on what was tested and why a choice was made, so decisions don't get revisited from scratch.


2. LLM & Conversational AI Development

- Build and improve conversational AI workflows for real time voice agents.

- Integrate and work hands on with OpenAI, Google Gemini, and Anthropic Claude APIs streaming responses, tool/function calling, structured output, and context caching.

- Design prompt and context engineering strategies for spoken conversation, including multilingual and code mixed Indian language interactions.

- Develop agentic workflows with tool calling that reason across multiple business processes.

- Build test harnesses that measure response quality, latency, and cost per conversation, and improve all three over time.


3. AI Intelligence Platform

Build the next generation of Aurra's intelligence layer, sold as a premium product to clients:

- AI powered lead scoring

- Conversation sentiment analysis

- Objection detection and pattern analysis

- Call quality and performance insights

- Personalized script recommendations

- Client health scoring

- ROI and cost per lead analytics

- Executive dashboards powered by AI generated insights

You'll own the data pipelines that turn raw call data into these outputs, and the dashboards that present them.


4. AI Automation & Workflow Engineering

- Design and build AI powered automation workflows using orchestration platforms (n8n, Make, or equivalent) and custom code where those platforms fall short.

- Automate hiring workflows, resume screening, AI interview assistants, and candidate evaluation pipelines.

- Build intelligent lead routing and follow up automation.

- Integrate AI services with CRMs, WhatsApp, Email, dashboards, and internal applications.

- Build workflows with real monitoring, retries, logging, and failure recovery.


Also Part of the Role Building & Running What You Ship


5. Backend & Systems Engineering

- Build Python services for the AI and voice layer agent runtime, LLM and speech provider integrations, and data pipelines.

- Build and maintain our Node.js / TypeScript (NestJS) backend and REST APIs campaign management, call orchestration, integrations, admin tooling, and client-facing endpoints.

- Work on real time, low latency systems: WebSocket services, streaming audio pipelines, event driven flows, and sub second response budgets.

- Design and evolve PostgreSQL schemas, write and manage migrations, and own data correctness.

- Integrate telephony providers, CRMs, messaging platforms, and client systems via REST APIs and webhooks.

- Write services that fail gracefully retries, timeouts, idempotency, and structured logging.


6. Frontend & Product Interfaces

- Build and extend our Next.js / React / TypeScript applications: campaign dashboards, call and session logs, analytics views, and agent/prompt configuration tools.

- Turn AI capabilities into usable product surfaces clean, functional interfaces you design the flow for and ship yourself.

- Implement real time UI where the product needs it: live call state, streaming transcripts, and session timelines.


7. Deployment, Infrastructure & Production Ownership

- Deploy, operate, and monitor the services you build across staging and production.

- Own Docker builds, container orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, environment and secrets management, and the release process.

- Provision and maintain self-hosted Linux servers on cloud VMs running our platform.

- Run cloud infrastructure on AWS (compute, managed Postgres, object storage, networking, DNS/TLS).

- Set up monitoring, alerting, and logging; investigate and fix production issues in the systems you own.

- Manage cloud and inference cost right sizing, scaling, and eliminating waste.

- Share responsibility with the Product Engineer for overall platform stability and uptime.


8. Growth Engineering & AI Integrations

- Build AI powered inbound lead processing and automated customer engagement flows.

- Integrate Meta Ads, websites, CRMs, and communication platforms.

- Enhance AI screening systems for both customers and job applicants.

- Support AI driven experimentation for new features and revenue opportunities.


REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS


- 13 years of hands-on software engineering experience shipping to production.

- LLM APIs in production OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, or comparable with real prompt engineering experience and a feel for where quality, latency, and cost trade off against each other.

- Comfortable comparing options with numbers you can set up a fair test, measure latency, accuracy, and cost, and back your recommendation with data rather than impressions.

- Python async/await and modern API frameworks (FastAPI or similar). Our AI, voice, and data pipeline work lives here.

- Node.js with TypeScript building and maintaining backend APIs in a structured framework (NestJS, Express, or comparable).

- React and Next.js you can build and ship a working dashboard end to end without a dedicated frontend engineer.

- PostgreSQL or a comparable relational database schema design, non trivial queries, and managing migrations (ORM experience welcome).

- Docker and Linux you've built images, debugged containers, and worked comfortably on a Linux server over SSH.

- Cloud deployment (AWS, GCP, or Azure) you have deployed, configured, and debugged your own services on real infrastructure, not just pushed to a managed PaaS.

- REST APIs, webhooks, and third party integrations built and maintained in production.

- Git and collaborative development workflows.

- Practical experience with automation platforms (n8n, Make, Zapier, or equivalent).

- Ability to independently research, prototype, deploy, and operate solutions with minimal supervision.

- Strong problem solving and experimentation mindset comfortable with ambiguity and unproven ground.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


- Voice and speech technology: streaming Speech to Text, low latency Text to Speech, voice activity detection, turn taking and barge in handling, or any voice agent framework.

- Multilingual conversational AI for Indian languages Tamil, Hindi, or English code mixed speech.

- Experience building AI agents / agentic workflows with tool calling.

- Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, and embeddings.

- Real time / streaming systems: WebSocket services, event driven backends, and streaming media over the network. Telephony: SIP, programmable voice APIs, call control webhooks, or contact centre systems.

- Experience running or fine tuning open weight models on self hosted infrastructure.

- Container orchestration (Kubernetes or a lightweight distribution) and CI/CD pipelines.

- Experience building analytics dashboards and reporting platforms.

- Observability tooling structured logging, metrics, and tracing.


WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT


- Not a research only or notebook only role, and not a pure application development role either the AI work is expected to reach production, and the full stack work exists to put it there.

- Not a customer support or client facing account management role.

- Not a design heavy role you'll build functional interfaces, not own visual design systems.

- Not a narrow specialist role you'll move across AI, backend, frontend, and infrastructure as the work demands.


WHY JOIN IMITATE LABS?


- Build cutting edge AI products used by businesses across India.

- Work directly with the Founder and influence product direction.

- Own high impact initiatives end to end ideation, build, deployment, and iteration.

- Experiment with the latest AI models and technologies.

- Ship products that generate measurable customer value and revenue.

- Join a fast moving startup where innovation translates directly into business impact.

  • Build Deploy - Experience taking an AI tool or agent from build to production; packaging (Docker), hosting, and monitoring in a real environment.

  • Bachelor or Master degree in computer engineering, Computer Science, or any other relevant specialization (e.g., AI/ML, Data Science, IT).

Experience

  • 1+ years of relevant experience in AI/ML engineering, software development, or applied AI projects.
  • You should be able to clearly demonstrate how you have used AI tools - including Claude - to build, deploy, and improve efficiency, quality, or speed in a professional context.

Location

THE ROLE
You will build the systems behind our internal AI intelligence layer and our client AI work. This is applied engineering on production systems with real users inside the company and real clients outside it. It is not a research post, and it is not a prompt writing post.
The work is varied by design. In a given quarter you might tune a retrieval pipeline that is returning the wrong chunks, design an authorisation model so an agent cannot read what its caller cannot read, benchmark two open weight models on a clients data to justify an on premises deployment, and then write the evaluation harness that proves the change was actually an improvement.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Build and maintain retrieval pipelines, covering chunking strategy, embedding selection, vector store performance and hybrid search behaviour. We run pgvector on PostgreSQL today.
- Design and ship agent workflows and tool calling systems, with attention to failure handling, cost and latency rather than demo quality output.
- Own model evaluation. Build the harnesses, define the metrics and produce the evidence that a change helped. We would rather have an unglamorous eval suite than a confident opinion.
- Deploy and operate inference workloads on GCP and Vertex AI, and contribute to sizing and configuration for on premises open weight model hosting.
- Integrate AI capability into the wider product surface through APIs, webhooks and event driven pipelines.
- Work with the AI Product Owner to turn requirements into technical designs, and push back when the requirement and the technology disagree.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
- Strong Python, and comfort in a production codebase rather than only in notebooks.

- Frontend competence in React or Next.js, enough to build a working interface for your own systems.

In your first ninety days you will ship one meaningful improvement to retrieval quality on the internal AI platform with measurement to back it, and take independent ownership of at least one client facing AI component.

The ideal candidate brings strong enterprise application development experience, deep understanding of business logic–driven systems, solid relational database skills, and working familiarity with cloud infrastructure.   • Analyze and extend complex business logic across operational workflows such as order management, production, inventory, and finance.

  • Experience maintaining and modernizing legacy or monolithic applications.

Why Join Amtech

At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Golden Jackal Studios is building one of Indias first AI-first kids animation studios. Were looking for a hands-on AI Automation Engineer who can build the backend systems and workflow pipelines that power our content generation stack. You will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining automation workflows that connect creative tools, internal systems, cloud infrastructure, and production processes. This includes helping us automate parts of image, video, audio, and asset workflows so the studio can create content faster, more reliably, and at higher quality.


This is not a pure research or model-building role. We are looking for an engineer first someone who enjoys building working systems, integrating APIs, managing cloud workflows, and solving production problems in a fast-moving environment.


WHAT YOULL DO

Workflow Automation & Pipeline Building

  • Build and maintain automated workflows for creative production across image, video, audio, and related operations
  • Use tools like n8n, along with custom scripts and services, to orchestrate multi-step production pipelines
  • Connect generation tools, storage systems, internal databases, and review workflows
  • Design systems with retries, fallbacks, queueing, logging, and monitoring
  • Reduce manual effort in content production through robust workflow design

API Integration & Orchestration

  • Integrate third-party APIs across media generation, voice, transcription, storage, notifications, and workflow tools
  • Build webhook-based and event-driven systems across multiple services
  • Handle authentication, payload design, async jobs, rate limits, and failure recovery
  • Create lightweight services to validate, transform, and route data between tools
  • Ensure systems are modular so new tools can be added as the stack evolves

Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment

  • Deploy and manage automation systems on Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Work with services such as Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub,Cloud Storage, Firestore, and related infrastructure
  • Manage job execution, scheduling, storage, and backend services required for production workflows
  • Improve system reliability, speed, and cost efficiency
  • Support containerized or script-based deployments where needed

Engineering for Production

  • Write production-grade code in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Build internal backend utilities and services to support automated content workflows
  • Monitor system performance and debug failures across connected tools and services
  • Document workflows, system logic, and infrastructure clearly
  • Help create a maintainable and scalable technical backbone for the studio

Internal Tooling & Creative Interfaces

  • Build lightweight internal web tools that let the creative team interact with production
  • workflows submitting loglines, reviewing generated images, approving or refining video outputs

Collaboration & Systems Thinking

  • Work closely with creative and product teams to convert messy manual workflows into clean technical systems
  • Understand production bottlenecks and engineer around them
  • Balance speed with reliability in a startup environment
  • Evaluate new tools and APIs for integration into the workflow stack
  • Help shape the long-term architecture of the studios automation layer

Tools & Technologies

  • Make.com, n8n or similar workflow orchestration tools
  • GCP (Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Firestore, BigQuery)
  • Python and/or JavaScript / TypeScript
  • APIs, webhooks, OAuth, JSON payloads, background jobs, and async workflows
  • Git / GitHub
  • Docker (preferred)
  • Comfort using no-code/low-code UI tools (such as Lovable, Retool, or similar)
  • FFmpeg or media-processing workflows (preferred)
  • Familiarity with AI-powered APIs or creative tools is a plus
  • ComfyUI or open-source model workflows (optional)

Engineering Strengths

  • Strong backend and automation fundamentals
  • Good understanding of event-driven systems and async workflows
  • Ability to debug complex multi-step automations
  • Ability to design systems, not just scripts
  • Good sense of modularity, maintainability, and reliability
  • Comfort working with production systems in a fast-changing environment

Mindset

  • Loves building real working systems
  • Learns fast and adapts quickly
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging ability
  • Detail-oriented and structured
  • Comfortable working independently
  • Enjoys turning chaos into process

Nice to Have

  • Experience integrating image, video, voice, or transcription tools
  • Experience in a startup, content, or applied AI environment
  • Familiarity with cloud and API cost optimisation

Krishnakumar, Loomlight Interactive

Phone: +91 96336 33744 / +91 97421 51616

descriptionFromApi:
Job Summary

You'll help build the backend and ML platforms that turn multi-sensor satellite data into geospatial intelligence and you'll build them to run fully air-gapped and offline, deployed inside defense and intelligence environments with no internet access.

What you'll actually do

  • Build and maintain backend services and APIs that fuse satellite data (SAR + MSI) and serve geospatial analytics to analysts.
  • Design and work with databases and data flows for large raster/imagery datasets; model the data, write queries and pipelines that hold up at scale.
  • Put ML models behind reliable, self-hosted services: take something that works in a notebook and make it a monitored, production service that runs offline.
  • Work on inference and ML pipelines for imagery/geospatial analytics: batching, latency vs. throughput, GPU constraints, keeping things healthy in an air-gapped deployment.
  • Contribute to analyst-facing and agentic tooling components that chain steps, call local tools, and support intelligence workflows (and fail gracefully when they don't).
  • Debug systems where "correct" is fuzzy, and build the evals and monitoring that tell us whether a change actually made things better.

What you'll learn here

  • Because this matters as much as the work:
  • How to build production ML and data systems under real constraints offline, on-prem, security-first a skill very few engineers ever develop.
  • How to reason about systems that are probabilistic-ally correct, not just pass/fail.
  • Applied geospatial/EO machine learning and multi-sensor data fusion, mentored by [a lead with ML engineering experience / the team].
  • How to stay sharp without managed services reading source code and papers, and self-hosting what others just call an API for.

Requirements

  • ~1-2 years of backend engineering / ML engineering experience.
  • Strong fundamentals you understand why, not just which framework method to call. You can reason about what happens between a request arriving and a response leaving.
  • Systematic debugging. When something breaks, you form a hypothesis, reproduce it, and narrow it down you don't just try random fixes. (This matters double when you can't google your way out live.)
  • Evidence you learn fast and on your own. You've picked up something hard recently and can explain both the thing and how you learned it.
  • You surface blockers early and communicate clearly when you're stuck.
  • Comfort with constraints and process. Security discipline, careful data handling, and working within an air-gapped environment are part of the job, not obstacles to route around.
  • Curiosity about ML/AI with some hands-on exposure ideally you've run a model locally/self-hosted rather than only via a cloud API.

Bonus (nice to have)

  • Geospatial / remote-sensing experience: GDAL, rasterio, QGIS, working with satellite imagery, SAR, or multi-spectral data.
  • Self-hosting or serving ML models on-prem (e.g. Triton, ONNX Runtime, local LLMs, vLLM).
  • Experience with air-gapped, on-prem, or high-security deployments; reproducible builds; offline package mirroring.
  • Familiarity with containerization for isolated environments (Docker/K8s), and GPU-based inference.
  • Exposure to observability, evals, or testing non-deterministic systems.

You will analyze ticket trends and platform telemetry to surface patterns and translate them into actionable inputs for the right team.
You will validate API behavior across client gateway backend chains; clearly distinguish client-side failures (payload, auth, headers) from server-side issues (latency, errors, downtime).
You will support deployment validation and production release monitoring and automate repeatable checks wherever possible.

Reduced MTTR for critical and high-priority issues.
SLA adherence for issue response and resolution.
Volume of recurring tickets eliminated through tooling, automation, or permanent fixes.
Dashboard adoption - stakeholders actively using operational views built by this role.
Reduction in manual, repetitive operational tasks over time.

You have hands-on experience with ticketing systems (Jira, ServiceNow, or Zendesk) and API testing tools (Postman or equivalent).

You have experience with Observability Dashboarding - designing monitoring views that surface the right signal for engineering and business stakeholders.
You have experience with Utility Development - writing tools that solve operational problems at scale, not just one ticket at a time.
You have experience with API Integration Tracing - tracing end-to-end flows and isolating failure ownership across client, gateway, and backend layers.
You have experience with Pattern Recognition - moving from individual incidents to systemic insight; knowing when a ticket is a symptom, not the cause.
You have strong Cross-functional Communication skills - translating technical findings into precise, timestamped artifacts that engineering teams can act on immediately.

You have experience working in SaaS platform environments.
You have exposure to production release monitoring and deployment validation.
You have experience building operational tooling and automation workflows.

jobDescription:
We are looking forward to hire Microsoft Fabric Professionals in the following areas :

: Data Engineer (Mid-Senior)
Experience Level: 5+ Years ( Microsoft Fabric: 1-2 Years )
Role Overview
We are seeking a Data Engineer with 5+ years of experience to design and implement scalable data solutions on Microsoft Fabric . You will be a key technical contributor, responsible for building end-to-end data pipelines, managing OneLake storage, and ensuring the reliability of Lakehouse and Warehouse environments. This role requires a professional who has already transitioned into the Fabric ecosystem and can independently deliver complex data engineering tasks.
Key Responsibilities
  • Fabric Pipeline Engineering: Design and develop production-grade ETL/ELT workflows using Fabric Data Factory , Dataflows Gen2 , and Notebooks .
  • Data Lake Management: Implement and manage OneLake organization and Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) to ensure data quality and performance.
  • Advanced Spark Development: Write and optimize PySpark and Spark SQL code for high-volume data processing and transformation.
  • Semantic Modeling: Build and maintain Power BI semantic models (Direct Lake / Import) to support enterprise reporting requirements.
  • DevOps Automation: Manage Fabric artifacts using Git integration and deployment pipelines (CI/CD) in Azure DevOps or GitHub.
  • Performance Optimization: Conduct performance tuning of Spark clusters and SQL queries to ensure cost-efficient capacity utilization in Fabric.
  • Collaboration: Partner with Lead Engineers and Architects to implement data governance, security (RLS/OLS), and cataloging within Microsoft Purview .
Must-Have Skills
  • Experience: 4+ years of overall data engineering experience.
  • Microsoft Fabric: 1-2 years of proven, hands-on experience with core Fabric components (Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, and Data Factory).
  • Core Technicals: Expert-level SQL and strong proficiency in PySpark .
  • Data Architecture: Proven experience implementing dimensional models and Lakehouse patterns.
  • Azure Foundations: Solid understanding of ADLS Gen2, Azure SQL, and Key Vault as they integrate with Fabric.
  • Modern DevOps: Experience with Git-based version control and automated deployment workflows for data.
Good-to-Have Skills
  • Real-Time Intelligence: Experience with KQL or Eventstreams within the Fabric ecosystem.
  • Migrations: Previous experience migrating workloads from Azure Synapse or Databricks to Fabric.
  • Certifications: Microsoft DP-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate) or DP-700 (Fabric Data Engineer Associate).
  • Governance: Exposure to data lineage and sensitivity labeling within Microsoft Purview.
Soft Skills Education
  • Mindset: A quality-first approach with a strong "bias for action" in solving technical debt.
  • Communication: Ability to clearly document technical designs and collaborate in a pod-based team structure.
  • Education: Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related Engineering field.

Our Hyperlearning workplace is grounded upon four principles

  • Flexible work arrangements, Free spirit, and emotional positivity
  • Agile self-determination, trust, transparency, and open collaboration
  • All Support needed for the realization of business goals,
  • Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture

The Employee Life Cycle Analyst (Tier 1) plays a key frontline role in APAC HR Operations, ensuring core employee life cycle transactions are delivered accurately, on time, and with care.   • Strong attention to detail and comfort working with HR systems and data
  • Exposure to onboarding, data handling and reporting is a strong advantage

Job Summary

Were looking for a Senior Salesforce QA Tester to support our platform team as we build out Revenue Cloud Advanced, a custom Lightning Web Component (LWC) front end for product discovery / browse flows, and an ongoing Salesforce-Dynamics 365 integration (built on Microsoft Fabric and event-driven patterns). Youll validate configuration changes, catch regressions before they reach production, and bring structure to testing across a fast-moving, technically complex org.

This is a hands-on testing role, not purely manual click-through QA. Youll need to get comfortable with Salesforce configuration concepts (flows, sharing rules, validation rules, sandboxes) and ideally have some exposure to testing custom LWCs and integrations, not just the standard Salesforce UI.

Youll work closely with our Salesforce development team - a mix of Architects, Developers, and Admins - collaborating directly with them to validate changes, reproduce defects, and coordinate test cycles.

Responsibilities

  • Revenue Cloud Advanced testing - validating Product Discovery / Browse Products flows, pricing logic, and configurator behaviour, including a custom LWC replacing the standard flow-based UI
  • Regression testing - across sandboxes as new features and bug fixes are deployed (e.g. validating fixes to LWC/connector issues, pricebook and pricing behaviour)
  • Integration testing - for the Salesforce and Dynamics 365 data flows (batch syncs via Microsoft Fabric/ADF, and event-driven flows via Platform Events/CDC to Azure Service Bus to D365)
  • Configuration validation - sharing rules, validation rules, flow orchestration (including mobile approval flows), campaign/campaign-member setups, and permission/profile changes
  • Test case documentation - writing and maintaining test scripts, tracking defects, and clearly documenting reproduction steps for developers
  • UAT support - helping coordinate or execute user acceptance testing cycles with business stakeholders

What Were Looking For

Required

  • 3+ years of hands-on QA/testing experience, with at least 1-2 years testing Salesforce specifically
  • Comfortable navigating Salesforce Setup, sandboxes, and basic configuration concepts (objects, flows, validation rules, sharing models)
  • Experience writing structured test cases/scripts and tracking defects (Jira or similar)
  • Strong written communication - youll often be documenting bugs for a small, fast-moving team rather than a large QA org
  • Ability to work with meaningful autonomy and manage your own testing cycles against sprint/release timelines

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to Salesforce Revenue Cloud / CPQ testing (pricing, product configuration, quoting)
  • Experience testing custom Lightning Web Components (not just standard page/flow UI)
  • Experience testing HubSpot / Salesforce integration
  • Familiarity with Certinia PSA
  • Comfort using AI-assisted testing tools to accelerate test-case generation, test-data creation, and regression coverage (e.g. Copilot-style assistants or AI test-authoring in tools such as Provar/Testim/Tosca)
  • Basic SOQL for data validation
  • Exposure to integration testing (APIs, middleware, ETL/data-sync tools)
  • Salesforce certifications (e.g. Certified Administrator, or QA-specific certs) - a plus, not required

Logistics

":" About Jetbro

We are looking for an Elixir Developer to join our team building backend services for scalable, production-grade applications. This is not a role where you simply execute PRDs. Instead, you will be a business-minded engineer who deeply understands the product use cases, business objectives, and strategic implications of technical decisions.

You will design and extend backend services using the Ash Framework, working across resources, actions, and data layers to ship features fast without sacrificing correctness. Our backend is Elixir/Phoenix with Ash as the core application framework, backed by PostgreSQL, deployed on Fly.io. You will spend most of your time inside Ashs resource-oriented patterns rather than hand-rolling boilerplate.

This is a framework-deep role with a business-first mindset. You will actively collaborate with product managers, business stakeholders, and leadership to understand the why behind features, ask clarifying questions, and contribute to strategic technical decisions. You will use AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as everyday tools, and youll also work hands-on with LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini) to build AI-powered features, not just use AI to write code. Computational Aeroelasticity Software Developer

Position Overview

Cadence Design Systems is seeking a highly motivated Computational Aeroelasticity Software Developer to contribute to the development of next-generation aeroelastic and aerothermoelastic simulation technologies spanning subsonic through hypersonic flight applications. This role is ideal for a recent Ph. D. graduate, postdoctoral researcher, or early-career engineer with research experience in computational aeroelasticity, multidisciplinary simulation, scientific computing, or related fields.

Key Responsibilities

Computational Aeroelasticity & Aerothermoelasticity Development

Contribute to the development, verification, validation, and deployment of advanced aeroelastic simulation capabilities, including:

Low-Fidelity Methods

  • Panel methods, Doublet Lattice Method (DLM), and Vortex Lattice Method (VLM)
  • Generalized aerodynamic force generation
  • Linearized and frequency-domain aerodynamic modeling

Medium-Fidelity Methods

  • Hybrid CFD-panel methodologies
  • Reduced-order and surrogate modeling
  • Transonic correction techniques
  • Time-domain aeroelastic formulations
  • Flexible vehicle dynamic simulation methods

High-Fidelity Methods

  • CFD-based aeroelasticity using Euler and Navier-Stokes solvers
  • Fluid-structure interaction (FSI) and CFD-CSD coupling
  • Nonlinear aeroelasticity and aerothermoelasticity
  • High-speed and hypersonic aeroelastic analysis

Support the development of solutions for:

  • Static and dynamic aeroelasticity
  • Flutter prediction
  • Divergence and control reversal
  • Gust response and aeroservoelasticity
  • Buffet response and limit-cycle oscillations
  • Nonlinear aeroelastic behavior

Work with senior technical staff to transition advanced research concepts into production-quality commercial software.

Hypersonic & High-Speed Flight Simulation

Contribute to the development of simulation technologies for high-speed and hypersonic vehicle applications, including:

  • Hypersonic aerodynamics and aerothermodynamics
  • Shock-wave/boundary-layer interactions
  • Thermal-structural coupling and aerothermoelasticity
  • High-temperature flight environments
  • Flight stability and control at high Mach numbers

Participate in the implementation and validation of numerical methods such as:

  • Piston theory
  • Supersonic and hypersonic aerodynamic methods
  • Shock-expansion techniques
  • Reduced-order models
  • CFD-based aeroelastic methodologies

Prior research experience in one or more of these areas is highly desirable.

Multidisciplinary Simulation & Structural Dynamics

Collaborate with structural dynamics, CFD, and multiphysics development teams to build integrated simulation workflows.

Contribute to:

  • Modal analysis and structural dynamics
  • Dynamic response analysis
  • Eigenvalue extraction methods
  • Coupled aerodynamic-structural simulations
  • Thermal stress and buckling analyses
  • Large-scale finite element modeling

Support applications involving:

  • Commercial and military aircraft
  • Rotorcraft and UAVs
  • Hypersonic vehicles
  • Space and launch systems
  • Advanced aerospace and defense platforms

Scientific Software Development

Develop robust and scalable commercial software capabilities, including:

  • Numerical algorithms and solver development
  • Scientific software architecture
  • APIs and workflow automation
  • Multiphysics integration frameworks
  • Verification and validation methodologies
  • Automated testing and continuous integration practices

Participate in the full software development lifecycle from research prototype to commercial product deployment.

High-Performance Computing

Contribute to the development and optimization of scalable simulation technologies using:

  • Parallel computing concepts
  • MPI, OpenMP, GPU, or accelerator technologies
  • Cloud and distributed computing environments

Optimize algorithms for large-scale engineering simulations and advanced aerospace workflows. Prior experience is beneficial but not required.

Customer & Industry Engagement

Work with technical experts, product teams, and customers to:

  • Understand aerospace simulation requirements
  • Support technical demonstrations

Description :

Alice.io (formerly known as ActiveFence) is a leading trust, safety, and security company. Just like Alice herself, we go down the rabbit hole into the emerging world of AI and focus on safeguarding these technologies. In a world where AI has fundamentally changed the nature of risk, Alice offers coverage across the entire AI lifecycle.

We're currently on the ground floor of an exciting new initiative : The Alice Collective - an elite network of the world's premier cyber specialists focused on high-stakes, project-based work for the "best of the best" red-teamers in the industry.

Work is on-demand and project-dependent, scaling up and down based on the needs of the clients. This is not a high-volume, repetitive role; it is an opportunity to be tapped for specific, high-impact interventions when your unique expertise is required and to create a source of secondary income.

The most sophisticated technology challenges in the world are waiting down the rabbit hole. Were looking for the sharpest minds to help us secure the frontier.

The invitation is open : Come join us at the tea party.

About the position :

As one of Alices Security Red Team Specialist freelancers, you'll focus on Generative AI Models. You will play a critical role in enhancing the security and integrity of our cutting-edge AI technologies.

Your primary responsibility will be to conduct analysis and testing of our generative AI systems, including but not limited to language models, image generation models, and any related infrastructure.

Your objective is to help clients secure their AI models and frameworks by identifying weaknesses, assessing risks, and providing clear steps for improvement.

Key Responsibilities :

- Simulated Cyber Attacks : Conduct sophisticated and comprehensive simulated attacks on generative AI models and their operating environments to uncover vulnerabilities.

- Vulnerability Assessment : Evaluate the security posture of AI models and infrastructure, identifying weaknesses and potential threats.

- Risk Analysis : Perform thorough risk analysis to determine the impact of identified vulnerabilities and prioritize mitigation efforts.

- Mitigation Strategies : Collaborate with development and security teams to develop effective strategies to mitigate identified risks and enhance model resilience.

- Research and Innovation : Stay abreast of the latest trends and developments in AI security, ethical hacking, and cyber threats. Apply innovative testing methodologies to ensure cutting-edge security practices.

- Documentation and Reporting : Maintain detailed documentation of all red team activities, findings, and recommendations. Prepare and present reports to senior management and relevant stakeholders.

Requirements :

Must-Have :

- Proven experience in AI vulnerabilities analysis

- Strong understanding of AI technologies and their underlying architectures, especially generative models and agentic frameworks.

- At Least 5 years of experience in Web Penetration testing.

- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

- Ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment.

Nice-to-Have :

- Proficiency in Python or NodeJS

- Advanced Certifications in offensive cybersecurity (e.g. OSWE, OSCE3, SEC542, SEC522) are highly desirable.

- Familiarity with agentic frameworks and agentic development experience

- Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.

- Proven records for vulnerability disclosure, such as CVE

All applicants will be required to complete a screening exam and background check.

jobDescription:
We are hiring an Operations & Events Executive to help run the day-to-day of an established organisation in the international education sector, and to own the delivery of its events.


This is a hands-on ownership role. We run a calendar of programmes, awards, summits, roundtables and student events across India and the UK, we work with a large number of universities, and we have a community of members and volunteers spread across the country. Much of it currently depends on personal effort and individual follow-up, and this role exists to turn that into an operation that runs to a system, and to deliver the set-piece events to a real standard.


This is a fully remote role. We are open to candidates from anywhere.


Working hours Monday to Friday: 9am to 6pm UK time.

Saturday: 9am to 1:30pm UK time.


The Role: AI-native, used centrally throughout


You will:

  • Help own the operating calendar across every programme and event
  • Be part of the team day to day: set the rhythm, run the check-ins, hold people to a standard
  • Help own the set-piece events end to end: planning, suppliers, venues, budgets, run sheets, and the delivery itself, directing the on-ground coordinators and volunteers who deliver in person.
  • Coordinate volunteer and ambassador network that delivers much of what happens
  • Keep every workstream moving, projects, partnerships, events and community, and always be able to say what is on track, what is at risk, and what needs a decision.
  • Turn recurring work into process: SOPs, trackers and tooling, so the second run takes half the effort of the first.
  • Help own budgets and spend across operations and events: what was approved, what was spent, and why they differ.
  • Manage suppliers and contracts, and hold them to what they agreed.
  • Report upwards clearly and without being asked, and take work and decisions off the leadership as trust builds.
  • Use AI across your workflow: planning, drafting, tracking, reporting, automation and beyond.

What we're looking for

  • Experience across operations, programme management and event delivery
  • Proven event delivery: you have personally helped produced significant events end to end, including run sheets.
  • Able to deliver at a distance, through people on the ground, without losing control of the detail.
  • Highly organised in practice, not in description: nothing dropped, everything tracked, follow-up without a reminder.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and with building the structure yourself. There is no finished playbook.
  • The ceiling and the appetite to grow into running the whole operation.
  • Excellent written and spoken English. Much of the coordination is written, and much of it is with senior people.
  • Genuine, demonstrable fluency with AI tools as part of how you work, with concrete examples.
  • Comfortable working fully remote, to UK hours, with high autonomy.

Nice to have

  • Experience running or coordinating volunteers, ambassadors, chapters or a member community.
  • Experience in the education, student, non-profit, membership body or association sector.
  • Content Creation/Digital Marketing/Social Media Experience
  • Conference or summit production, awards, or sponsor-funded events.
  • Having built an operating model rather than only running an existing one.
  • Automation and tooling: Notion, Airtable, n8n, Zapier, or AI-driven workflows.

jobDescription:
Role Purpose


The Analyst Supply Solutions is responsible for delivering accurate and timely purchase order execution while elevating the function from transactional processing to AI-enabled, data-driven decision support. The role combines operational discipline, strong analytical judgment, and practical program management to improve service levels, reduce delays, and solve supplier-facing execution risks at scale.


What Success Looks Like

  • Order cycles run on time with high transaction quality and clear exception ownership.
  • Teams receive proactive, insight-led recommendations rather than passive status reporting.
  • Supplier delay risks are identified early, triaged correctly, and resolved through structured action plans.
  • AI and automation improve speed, consistency, and quality of operational decisions.
  • Cross-functional governance is reliable, transparent, and outcome-focused.

Core Responsibilities

A. Operational Execution and Control

  • Execute weekly ordering for replenishment and non-replenishment purchase orders with strong data accuracy.
  • Manage the PO lifecycle, including revisions, status tracking, exception logging, and issue closure.
  • Coordinate supply chain interruption updates (for example: factory constraints, shipment slippages, and recovery plans).
  • Publish concise progress updates for business stakeholders with clear decisions, actions, and ownership.
  • Maintain SOPs and control documents with disciplined versioning and audit readiness.

B. AI and Advanced Analytics (Mandatory)

  • Analyze demand, forecast, and order signals to detect outliers, risk clusters, and recurring root causes.
  • Use AI-assisted tools responsibly for anomaly detection, prioritization logic, and insight generation.
  • Develop practical analytical frameworks to separate urgent exceptions from low-impact noise.
  • Convert complex analysis into simple business narratives for planners, merchants, and leadership teams.
  • Build scalable KPI views and dashboards that improve action speed and accountability.
  • Measure and communicate impact of AI and automation using baseline-versus-outcome metrics.

C. Supply Solutions (Mandatory)

  • Lead structured problem-solving for supplier delay scenarios, from detection to closure.
  • Run cross-functional action plans with sourcing, planning, logistics, and supplier partners to recover at-risk orders.
  • Define and track delay recovery playbooks, including alternatives such as re-prioritization, partial allocation, and timeline resets.
  • Create and maintain early-warning indicators for supplier performance and delivery risk.
  • Drive weekly risk reviews with clear escalations, dependency management, and decision logs.
  • Recommend systemic fixes that reduce repeat delay patterns and improve planning reliability.

D. Collaboration and Capability Building

  • Partner with product and technology teams to design, test, and deploy process improvements.
  • Coach team members on structured analytics, data interpretation, and exception triage methods.
  • Ensure compliance with policies, data quality standards, and responsible AI usage principles.

Added Advantage: Apparel and Fashion Domain Knowledge

  • Understanding of apparel and fashion supply chain dynamics, including seasonality, lead-time sensitivity, and style-level variability.
  • Awareness of fashion lifecycle constraints such as launch windows, trend-driven demand shifts, and markdown risk.
  • Ability to interpret supplier and capacity constraints in the context of apparel and fashion planning cycles.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 4-6 years of relevant experience in order management, supply chain, retail, CPG, or a similar environment.
  • Advanced Excel and strong working knowledge of SQL for analysis, validation, and insight generation.
  • Demonstrated analytical strength in framing hypotheses, identifying root causes, and driving actions.
  • Strong stakeholder communication and program-tracking skills in cross-functional environments.
  • Experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent).
  • Experience applying AI-enabled methods in operations, planning, or analytics.
  • Experience in supplier performance programs and delay recovery governance.

About Lokal :
In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online. This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they ve always deserved.
We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:
    • Edutainment & Skill Learning - practical skills and learning in regional languages ( GyanTV )

    • Social & Community - Place to find & post social updates ( Lokal app )
    • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support - safe spaces to talk and feel heard ( Dostt & Eaze )
    • Astrology & Guidance - instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice ( AstroLokal)
    • Advisory Services - early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more
Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we ve built, they don t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.
This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre - access changes lives.
We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.
We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital.

descriptionFromApi:
About Us
We re Bolt.new by StackBlitz!
We re the team that brought you WebContainers, the first-of-its-kind technology that made it possible to run Node.js right inside your browser. That breakthrough kicked off our journey in 2019, and it s what powers the blazing-fast online IDE used by over 1 million developers every month.
But we didn t stop there. We doubled down on everything we learned and built Bolt.new - the fastest way to go from idea to production without writing traditional code. It s a next-gen, AI-powered app builder that helps you create, edit, and deploy full-stack web and mobile apps instantly, right in your browser. No installs. No setup. Just smart automation and instant dev environments that let you move at the speed of thought.
We re a fully remote team, globally distributed, deeply collaborative, and seriously passionate about building the future of software development.
This is your chance to join a small team with a big vision. If you love shipping fast, solving real problems, and pushing the boundaries of what s possible, we d love to meet you.
About This Opportunity
Bolt is a product made of language. People describe what they want in words, an agent builds it, and they judge the result without ever reading the code. That makes our words load-bearing in a way they arent in most products. It also means theres real craft available in nearly every surface, because weve grown fast and written as we go. Nobody is ahead of you in deciding what great looks like.
Youll be the first content designer at Bolt, and the job has two halves.
Own content as a discipline. Define the standard: the voice, the patterns, the vocabulary, and the reasons behind them. Then raise the bar on everyone elses words, most of which come from people who arent designers. Your value here is leverage, not volume. Success looks like PMs and engineers writing better content without you in the room.
Ship content-led features end to end, on your own. Not on day one. We have real content debt, and your first months go to the standard. After that, this becomes the other half of the job: feature onboarding, in-product education, the moments where a value prop has to land. Nobody is assigned to turn your thinking into screens. Youre the design DRI, in Figma or with agentic tools, through to shipped.
We move fast, and the problems are ambiguous. If the second half reads as daunting rather than fun, this isnt your role. If its the job youve been waiting for someone to hand you, we should talk.
How Youll Contribute
  • Set the standard and make it the default. Define Bolts product voice, terminology, and patterns for the moments that repeat: prompts, errors, empty states, permissions, billing, settings. Then put it where the work happens, in the design system, in components, in internal agents, so good copy holds up at the speed we ship.
  • Raise the bar on everyones words. Review writing from across the company and give feedback that improves peoples judgment, not only the sentence in front of you.
  • Own the content strategy. Bring a point of view on what we should say, when, and how much. Shape product direction from problem definition rather than copy-editing at the end.
  • Ship content-led features end to end. Feature onboarding, in-product education, the moments where a value prop has to land. Youre the design DRI: you scope it, design it in Figma or build it with agentic tools, and drive it through implementation without a product design partner.
  • Work across the whole lifecycle. Partner with Marketing and CX so that what we say before someone arrives, inside the product, and after they hit a problem all reinforce each other.
Qualifications
  • A portfolio of product content work with at least two examples where you can show the problem, your reasoning, what you rejected, and what changed after it shipped. Complex products, real scale. We care more about judgment than polish.
  • You can take a content-led feature from problem to shipped without a product designer. That means designing it in Figma, or building it with agentic tools, to a standard wed actually ship. If your process depends on someone else turning your words into screens, this role will frustrate us both.
  • Youve built a standard, a system, or a set of guidelines that other people actually used. Bonus points if youve watched one fail and can explain why.
  • You can give feedback that lands, including to people outside design who didnt ask for it and dont share your vocabulary, and to other writers as a peer rather than a manager.
  • Strong verbal and written English communication skills are required, as this role involves frequent collaboration with team members, stakeholders, and customers where English is the primary working language.
Bonus Points
  • Startup or small team experience. You are not just one of many!
  • Experience shaping AI tools, or writing for products where the interface is a conversation.
  • Experience writing for product, marketing and support content, or migrating knowledge between them.
  • Consumer product experience.
A Few Notes
  • You do not need a college degree to apply
  • You do not need to be located in the U.S. - we re remote-friendly
  • You do not need to meet every qualification listed above
