About the Role
Bolster has partnered with a major technology provider (the Partner ) to offer a white-labeled version of our brand protection solution to the Partners customer base. Were hiring a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to act as the primary technical liaison between Bolster and the Partner, making sure customers who purchase our solution through this partnership get the support they actually need - especially when that need falls outside what the Partner provides at no additional cost.
The Partner supports its customers through several layers: a Service Account Manager who handles account, billing, and user-management matters; a baseline technical support team that provides break-fix support; paid integration packages that help with configuration and training; and a range of paid professional/managed services offering deeper technical support and named account resources. This TAM will need to understand that structure well enough to know exactly where the Partners support ends and where Bolster needs to step in - and then be the one who steps in.
This same TAM will also support named enterprise and strategic accounts sold directly by Bolster, acting as the primary product expert on calls alongside our enterprise Customer Success Managers to drive product adoption and expand how customers use the platform. In practice, this is a dual-motion role: one foot in the Partners support ecosystem, one foot embedded with Bolsters own enterprise book of business.
Work Authorization: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. We are not able to sponsor visas or provide employment-based immigration support for this position now or in the future.
What Youll Do
  • Serve as Bolsters primary point of contact for the Partners account and support teams - Service Account Managers, baseline technical support, and professional/managed services teams - on everything related to our white-labeled product.
  • Learn and navigate the Partners tiered support model well enough to identify, for any given customer issue, whether its covered by the Service Account Manager, baseline technical support, a paid integration package, or a professional/managed services offering - or whether it isnt covered by the Partner at all.
  • Work with the Partners professional/managed services teams to clarify which of our products and services fall within scope of each service package, and fill in context where their teams need it.
  • Act as the escalation point when a customer needs help beyond what the Partner provides for free: for example, deeper product configuration, ongoing tuning, or hands-on help that isnt included in a paid integration or in baseline technical support.
  • Support onboarding and managed integrations for the solution, including training customers both on initial setup and on ongoing maintenance - e.g., configuring automated takedowns and maintaining protected assets over time.
  • Track recurring support themes and pain points across accounts, and feed that back to our product, sales, and customer success teams so we can improve documentation, packaging, and pricing over time.
  • Build strong, collaborative relationships with the Partners account managers, support engineers, and services staff so that handoffs and escalations stay smooth on both sides.
Supporting Bolsters Enterprise Accounts
  • Serve as the dedicated technical resource for a portfolio of named enterprise and strategic accounts sold directly by Bolster, working in lockstep with each accounts Customer Success Manager.
  • Join CSM-led customer calls as the product expert - answering technical questions, unblocking issues in real time, and spotting opportunities to expand how the customer uses the platform.
  • Help enterprise customers configure and tune Bolsters monitoring and takedown workflows - across domains, social media, app stores, marketplaces, and the dark web - to fit their brands specific risk profile.
  • Stay current on the broader digital-risk and fraud-protection landscape so you can speak credibly to how Bolster fits alongside a customers other security and brand-protection investments.
  • Be the product expert on customer calls and continue to learn about adjacent technologies and services in the fraud space.
What Were Looking For
  • Experience in Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success Engineering, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
  • Experience working within a channel partner, reseller, or white-label business model - ideally with a large enterprise technology partner.
  • Comfortable supporting a portfolio of enterprise or strategic accounts alongside a Customer Success team, in addition to partner-sourced customers - this role covers both motions.
  • Solid understanding of tiered SaaS support models (break-fix vs. professional services vs. managed services vs. account management).
  • Strong communicator, comfortable acting as the bridge between teams - and between companies - and translating between business and technical stakeholders.
  • Self-directed and comfortable with ambiguity, while staying organized and reliable.
  • Preferred: experience with brand protection, anti-phishing, domain takedown, digital risk protection, or similar cybersecurity/brand-safety products.
  • Preferred: familiarity with common digital-abuse vectors - phishing, typosquatting/domain spoofing, social media and app-store impersonation, fraudulent ads, and marketplace scams - and how takedowns actually get executed (registrars, hosting providers, platform trust safety teams, DMCA/UDRP-style processes).
  • Preferred: comfort working with API-driven, integration-heavy products - Bolsters detection and takedown workflows rely heavily on automation and direct platform integrations.
  • Preferred: experience working with or alongside a Security Operations Center (SOC), fraud, or brand-security team on the customer side.
  • Preferred: familiarity with large enterprise technology partners support and services ecosystems.

-Excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance
-Flexible time off + paid holidays.
-Equity + 401(k) plan

title: Video Editor -Marathi (Marketing )
jobDescription:
About Lokal

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

  • Edutainment & Skill Learning - practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
  • Matrimonial Matchmaking - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
  • Agri Consulting - farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
  • Local Jobs - blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
  • Social & Community - Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
  • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support - safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
  • Astrology & Guidance - instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
  • Advisory Services - early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we ve built, they don t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre - access changes lives.We ship fast.

We learn fast. We build for Bharat.We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital


About the Role

We are looking for a highly creative and skilled Video Editor to join our content team. You will be responsible for crafting compelling short-form and mid-length video content across platforms - from social media reels to promotional videos and branded content. This role requires a deep understanding of storytelling, editing trends, platform dynamics, and cultural nuances to create content that drives engagement and delivers impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Edit short-form and mid-length videos such as reels, social media ads, promos, and content explainers.
  • Implement engaging hooks, dynamic pacing, and a strong narrative rhythm to maximize viewer retention.
  • Tailor editing styles to suit platform-specific behaviors (e.g., fast cuts for Instagram, scroll-stopping openers for YouTube Shorts).
  • Enhance video quality through thoughtful color grading, text animations, transitions, and immersive sound design.
  • Collaborate closely with writers, designers, and creative leads to bring scripts and visual concepts to life.
  • Stay updated on current editing trends, meme formats, cultural references, and audio trends to keep content fresh and relatable.
  • Analyze ad performance metrics and apply learnings to improve edits for better click-through and completion rates.
  • Edit videos in the required language Marathi, ensuring linguistic accuracy, cultural relevance, and strong storytelling for the target audience.
  • 1-2 years of experience in video editing for social media or digital content.
  • Proficiency in editing software like Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, or similar.
  • Strong portfolio of short-form content (reels, ads, promos).
  • Good understanding of social platform algorithms and engagement tactics.
  • Strong storytelling instincts, visual creativity, and sound design skills.
  • Language proficiency in Marathi & English and Ability to edit in Marathi with cultural sensitivity and linguistic command.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with tight deadlines.

Here at Frontier, we help companies grow full-time, cross-functional teams abroad. We hire the smartest people, and we place them into the best companies. In three years, we ve never lost a client.

If you like one of the Frontier roles, and you apply, and you re accepted, we ll screen you with a couple of internal interviews, and will work on getting you an interview for a full-time job within the month.

Think of us as your personal talent agent, and good luck with the application :)

About Tallee

Tallee is an AI Visibility platform that helps modern brands track, optimize, and improve how they appear across next-generation AI platforms and LLMs (such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google Gemini). As search and consumer discovery shift from traditional engines to AI, Tallee equips companies with the diagnostic insights, strategic roadmaps, and content ecosystem needed to ensure their brand is accurately represented and recommended.

About the Role

As a Technical Account Manager & AI Visibility Strategist, you will own client relationships while serving as the primary technical and strategic lead on brand AI visibility. This is not a traditional, relationship-only account management role - your core value lies at the intersection of technical credibility, diagnostic problem-solving, and strategic execution.

We heavily prioritize self-starters, particularly former founders or early-stage startup employees, who thrive in high-ownership, fast-evolving environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform deep audits of how client brands show up across major LLMs; diagnose exactly why a brand is or isnt being surfaced, mentioned, or accurately represented.
  • Analyze the brand s end-to-end digital footprint, including website content, product/ingredient data, YouTube, social channels, Reddit, and brand partnerships/sponsorships.
  • Translate technical audit insights into clear, actionable roadmaps (e.g., identifying gaps in editorial content, or ensuring major sponsorships/partnerships are structured properly on-site for LLM ingestion).
  • Establish foundational priorities and collaborate directly with founders, strategy teams, and clients to align on which content and brand initiatives should be produced.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Prior experience as a founder, co-founder, or early-stage employee at a fast-growing startup is strongly preferred.
  • Deep curiosity and practical understanding of LLMs, AI search mechanics, digital marketing, and modern SEO/content ecosystems.
  • Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to build trust through technical authority and analytical clarity.
  • Proven track record of diagnosing messy, unstructured digital data and turning it into structured strategy.

About Lokal

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they ve always deserved. We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

  • Edutainment & Skill Learning - practical skills and learning in regional languages ( GyanTV )
  • Matrimonial Matchmaking - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search ( Lokal Matrimony )
  • Agri Consulting - farmer-first advisory in local languages ( AgriLokal )
  • Lokal Jobs - blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home ( Lokal Jobs )
  • Social & Community - Place to find & post social updates ( Lokal app )
  • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support - safe spaces to talk and feel heard ( Dostt & Eaze )
  • Astrology & Guidance - instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice ( AstroLokal )
  • Advisory Services - early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we ve built, they don t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for. This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centere - access changes lives.

We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.

We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

About Lokal

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they ve always deserved. We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

  • Edutainment & Skill Learning - practical skills and learning in regional languages ( GyanTV )
  • Matrimonial Matchmaking - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search ( Lokal Matrimony )
  • Agri Consulting - farmer-first advisory in local languages ( AgriLokal )
  • Lokal Jobs - blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home ( Lokal Jobs )
  • Social & Community - Place to find & post social updates ( Lokal app )
  • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support - safe spaces to talk and feel heard ( Dostt & Eaze )
  • Astrology & Guidance - instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice ( AstroLokal )
  • Advisory Services - early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we ve built, they don t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for. This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centere - access changes lives.

We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.

We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

About the role :
We are looking for a hands-on Performance Marketing professional to manage end-to-end digital marketing-from running ads and creating content ideas to tracking and optimizing performance.
This is a high-ownership role where you will be responsible for results, not just execution. Training and guidance will be provided.

Key Responsibilities :

  • For each app you work on, youll study the audience, the market, and the competition - then write ads that get people to download and make that first purchase.
  • You decide the angle, the hook, the format, and the script - and you write it yourself.
  • Youll brief designers and video editors on your concepts and follow through until the output matches your intent.
  • Youll ship multiple creative variants per campaign (80-100 per week) - fast cycles, not one polished ad a week.
  • You run your own A/B tests, read the results, and decide what to try next.
  • You track whats working in each market and make sure the creative feels native to that audience.

Must-Have

  • 1-3 years of experience in performance marketing content or growth marketing.
  • Hands-on exposure to Meta Ads & Google Ads campaigns.
  • Strong copywriting skills (English + regional language preferred).
  • Understanding of performance metrics like CAC, ROAS, CPI, CTR.
  • Experience working with creative and video teams.
  • Data-driven mindset with strong analytical skills.
What We Offer :
  • End-to-end ownership of marketing
  • Training and mentorship from leadership
  • High learning curve with direct business impact
  • Performance-based growth opportunities
Why This Role Is Exciting :
  • You will directly drive growth through paid marketing and experiments
  • You will own end-to-end performance-from ads to insights and optimization
  • You will test, learn, and scale what works with real business impact
  • High visibility with leadership and a steep learning curve.

The candidate will approach and support customers whose systems were installed by our Company as well as systems installed by other companies.

  • Analyse generation, alarms, errors, logs, downtime and performance loss.

  • Maintain separate records for Company-installed and third-party-installed systems.
  • Update every customer discussion, response and next action in the CRM.

WhatsApp and Digital Outreach

  • Send approved WhatsApp broadcasts and customer questionnaires.
  • Respond to customer replies and register every valid enquiry in the CRM.
  • Publish Marketing Team-assigned posts on approved social-media platforms after initial training.
  • Follow the Companys content, branding and communication SOP.
  • Manage digital enquiries from the first response through quotation and sales conversion.
  • Coordinate technical support, payment, service visits and scheduling.
  • Keep customers updated until the service or sale is completed.
  • Close the CRM enquiry only after completing all records and customer communication.

Brand Service and Spare Follow-up

  • Register complaints with the relevant brand or authorised service centre when a product or spare is damaged or sent for repair.
  • Record the complaint number, product model, serial number, submission date and expected return date.
  • Follow up regularly until the repaired or replacement item is received.
  • Update the maintenance team and coordinate reinstallation and testing.
  • Inform the customer about repair progress, receipt, installation and final working status.
  • Close the call only after installation, testing, customer confirmation and CRM updates.

  • Strong data-analysis and reporting ability
  • Confident telephone, WhatsApp and customer communication
  • Basic understanding of solar systems, electricity bills or home automation
  • Familiarity with computers, smartphones, email, CRM and social media

  • Marathi, Hindi and basic English preferred

Performance Areas

  • Quality of Excel reports and presentations
  • Customer response and follow-up time
  • CRM data accuracy
  • Solar and home-automation leads generated

  • Conversion of Company-installed and third-party-installed systems
  • Brand repair and spare follow-up

title: Back End Software Developer
jobDescription:
Job Summary
The Senior Associate Software Development Engineer is a developing subject matter expert, tasked with supporting the designing, developing, and testing of software systems, modules, or applications for software enhancements and new products including cloud-based or internet-related tools.
This role is accountable for supporting detailed design for certain modules/sub-systems, doing prototype for multi-vendor infrastructure, and showcasing it internally or externally to clients.
This role designs and develops functionality in a micro-services environment working with APIs, telemetry data, and running ML/AI algorithms on it, working with both structured and unstructured data.
Responsibilities
  • Receives instructions to design and develop solutions and functionality that drives the growth of business.
  • Contributes to writing and testing code.
  • Supports the execution of automated testing.
  • Receives instructions from various stakeholders to participate in software deployment.
  • Supports the delivery of software components while working in collaboration with the product team.
  • Supports the integration and building of solutions through automation and coding, using 3rd party software.
  • Receives instructions to craft, build, and debug large scale distributed systems.
  • Supports writing, updating and maintaining the technical program, end-user documentation, and operational procedures.
  • Assists with refactoring code.
  • Contributes to the reviewing of code written by other developers.
  • Performs any other related task as required.
Requirements
  • Developing understanding of cloud architecture and services in multiple public clouds like AWS, GCP, Microsoft Azure, and Microsoft Office 365.
  • Subject matter expert in programming languages such as C/C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Python, Node.js, libraries and frameworks.
  • Developing expertise of data structures, algorithms, and software design with strong analytical and debugging skills.
  • Developing knowledge of micro services-based software architecture and experience with API product development.
  • Developing expertise in SQL and no-SQL data stores including Elasticsearch, MongoDB, Cassandra.
  • Developing understanding of container run time (Kubernetes, Docker, LXC/LXD).
  • Developing proficiency with agile, lean practices and believes in test-driven development.
  • Possess a can-do attitude and one that takes initiative.
  • Excellent ability to work well in a diverse team with different backgrounds and experience levels.
  • Excellent ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Developing proficiency with CI/CD concepts and tools.
  • Developing proficiency with cloud-based infrastructure and deployments.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
Workplace type: On-site
Academic qualifications and certifications
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
  • Microsoft Certified Azure Fundamentals preferred.
  • Relevant agile certifications preferred.
Required experience
  • Moderate level experience working with geo-distributed teams through innovation, bootstrapping, pilot, and production phases with multiple stakeholders to the highest levels of quality and performance.
  • Moderate level experience with tools across full software delivery lifecycle, for example. IDE, source control, CI, test, mocking, work tracking, defect management.
  • Moderate level experience in Agile and Lean methodologies, Continuous Delivery / DevOps, Analytics / data-driven processes.
  • Familiarity with working with large data sets and ability to apply proper ML/AI algorithms.
  • Moderate level experience in developing micro-services and RESTful APIs.
  • Moderate level experience in software development.

Position Overview
The Test Engineer will own hands-on quality engineering for the AWS Policy Master flow, with primary emphasis on automated data, API, integration, reconciliation, resilience, performance, and production-readiness testing. The role validates that policy feeds are accurately processed from S3 through Lambda and SQS into Aurora and are securely exposed through APIs. The engineer will collaborate closely with developers and business SMEs to build traceable test coverage, detect defects early, validate nonfunctional requirements, and provide objective release-readiness evidence.
Required Skills and Experience
  • 57 years of software testing or quality-engineering experience, including substantial automation experience on cloud, data, API, integration, or distributed-system programs.
  • Hands-on experience testing AWS-based solutions using services such as S3, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, Aurora PostgreSQL, API Gateway, CloudWatch, IAM, and KMS.
  • Strong skills in SQL and data validation, including source-to-target reconciliation, transformation-rule testing, referential integrity, duplicates, nulls, control totals, historical or effective-dated data, and exception validation.
  • Experience building automated test frameworks using Python, Java, or JavaScript and tools such as pytest, JUnit, REST Assured, Postman/Newman, Karate, or equivalent.
  • Experience with REST API testing covering contracts, schemas, authentication and authorization, pagination, versioning, throttling, negative scenarios, error responses, and performance.
  • Practical experience testing asynchronous and event-driven patterns, including message sequencing, duplicate delivery, idempotency, retry, dead-letter queues, replay, partial failure, and eventual consistency.
  • Experience with performance and reliability tools such as JMeter, Gatling, k6, or equivalent, plus observability through CloudWatch logs, metrics, dashboards, and alerts.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD quality gates, Git workflows, defect management, test-data management, environment readiness, and traceability from requirements to test evidence.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to isolate defects across application, data, infrastructure, and integration layers and communicate business impact clearly.
  • Insurance policy-domain knowledge, testing of policy administration or ODS solutions, and familiarity with PII or regulated-data controls are preferred; ISTQB or an AWS certification is an advantage.
Duties
  • Translate business, data, API, security, and nonfunctional requirements into a risk-based test strategy, detailed scenarios, automation scope, and entry or exit criteria.
  • Develop and execute automated tests across S3 landing, Lambda validation, SQS buffering, transformation processing, Aurora persistence, and API consumption.
  • Validate source-to-target mappings and canonical policy rules through record-level comparison, aggregate reconciliation, control totals, exception reporting, and negative-data scenarios.
  • Test asynchronous behavior including duplicate messages, out-of-order events, poison messages, retries, dead-letter queues, replay, timeout, partial failure, and recovery without data loss or corruption.
  • Automate API functional, contract, authorization, error-handling, throttling, versioning, and regression tests and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Execute performance, load, volume, endurance, concurrency, and resilience testing against agreed service levels; identify bottlenecks across Lambda, queues, Aurora, and APIs.
  • Validate security controls including least-privilege access, encryption, secrets handling, sensitive-data masking, audit events, and unauthorized-access behavior in partnership with security teams.
  • Create representative and privacy-compliant test data, manage test-data refreshes, and maintain reusable automated datasets and expected-results libraries.
  • Log high-quality defects with evidence, severity, reproducibility, impacted data or services, and likely failure layer; support triage, root-cause isolation, retesting, and closure.
  • Track coverage, automation rate, pass or fail trends, defect leakage, reconciliation results, performance findings, and residual risk; provide an evidence-based release recommendation.

descriptionFromApi:
About the Project

TSMG is looking for Quality control specialists to support an AI language project focused on improving speech recognition systems.

As a QC contributor, you will review completed language annotation tasks and ensure that AI-generated transcripts have been accurately converted into natural, readable display text according to the project guidelines. You will focus on identifying and correcting formatting, punctuation, capitalization, and text normalization issues.

What You Will Do
  • Review completed Display Transcription tasks for accuracy and consistency.
  • Compare the Display Transcription against the original lexical transcript and project guidelines.
  • Verify the correct use of:
    • punctuation;
    • capitalization;
    • numbers, dates, times, and currencies;
    • abbreviations and other text normalization rules.
  • Ensure that the original words and meaning have been preserved.
  • Identify and correct formatting or guideline-related errors.
  • Use the reference audio when necessary to verify ambiguous cases.
  • Apply project-specific quality standards consistently.
  • Provide accurate feedback and flag recurring issues when required.
  • Complete assigned QC tasks within project deadlines and productivity targets.
Requirements
  • Excellent written skills in the target language.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Good understanding of punctuation, capitalization, and written language conventions.
  • Ability to identify inconsistencies and errors in formatted text.
  • Ability to follow detailed guidelines and apply them consistently.
  • Basic computer skills and a reliable internet connection.
  • Ability to work independently and meet quality and productivity targets.
  • Previous experience in transcription, proofreading, quality control, annotation, or linguistic projects is a plus.
  • Training and project guidelines will be provided before the project starts.

  • Opportunity to contribute to the development of AI and speech recognition technologies.
  • Flexible project-based work.
  • Clear guidelines and training before starting.

By enabling Tier 1 retailers and marketplaces worldwide to activate more brands and leverage advanced targeting, we help them secure a lasting competitive edge.

Your Impact: We are seeking a highly motivated iOS Developer to join our team. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and maintain high-quality mobile applications that deliver seamless and engaging user experiences.

Job Summary

Osmos seeking a highly motivated iOS Developer to join our team. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and maintain high-quality mobile applications that deliver seamless and engaging user experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain high-performance mobile applications and Ads SDKs across iOS, and Flutter platforms
  • Take ownership of SDK development, integration, and optimization for client applications
  • Collaborate with product managers, backend engineers, and designers to define and implement scalable mobile solutions
  • Build reusable, modular, and maintainable code for both apps and SDK components
  • Ensure seamless integration with backend services via REST/GraphQL APIs
  • Optimize app and SDK performance (latency, memory usage, battery consumption, app size)
  • Debug and resolve complex issues including crashes, ANRs, and integration failures
  • Ensure consistent behavior and UI/UX across platforms and devices
  • Implement best practices for mobile security, data handling, and versioning
  • Manage app releases on Play Store and App Store and handle rollout strategies
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines for automated builds, testing, and releases
  • Monitor production performance (crashes, usage, SDK impact) and continuously improve reliability
  • Stay updated with evolving mobile technologies and propose improvements

You'll Thrive If You Have

  • 1-3 years of experience in iOS application development
  • Strong working knowledge of Swift and the iOS SDK
  • Hands-on experience with UIKit and/or SwiftUI
  • Basic understanding of iOS application architecture, such as MVC/MVVM
  • Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, networking, and asynchronous programming
  • Understanding of iOS app lifecycle, threading, and memory management (ARC)
  • Experience with Git and version control
  • Experience debugging crashes, UI issues, memory problems, and performance issues
  • Familiarity with tools such as Xcode Debugger, Instruments, and Firebase Crashlytics
  • Understanding of different iOS versions, screen sizes, and device compatibility
  • Basic understanding of unit testing and UI testing using XCTest/XCUITest
  • Exposure to third-party SDK integration; Ads SDK experience is a plus
  • Basic understanding of iOS app release and deployment using TestFlight/App Store
  • Ability to write clean, readable, and maintainable code
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and learning skills
  • Ability to take ownership of assigned features from development through testing and release
  • Good communication and collaboration skills with product, QA, backend, and engineering teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Ads/Monetization SDKs (video ads, display ads, programmatic)
  • Experience with WebView, hybrid apps, or JS bridges
  • Knowledge of Firebase, crash analytics, or performance monitoring tools
  • Published apps or SDKs on Play Store/App Store
  • Experience with offline support, caching, and low-network optimization

IND Senior Quality Engineer - GCC015

We re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals - and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.

Junior SDET

Location: Hyderabad, India

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience Level: 1 - 2 years

Position Overview

We are seeking Junior SDET to join our Premium Audit transformation team in Hyderabad, India. In this role, you will architect, implement, and scale automated testing for the Premium Audit platform spanning UI, API, data, and workflow layers. Y ou ll enable high-velocity delivery by building robust automation frameworks (Playwright, REST Assured), integrating quality gates into CI/CD pipelines, and collaborating with Engineering, Product, and Ops to ensure releases are secure, reliable, and performant.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support test preparation and validation activities , including writing simple SQL queries, preparing test data, performing regression checks in CI/CD pipelines, and collaborating with engineers and BAs to clarify requirements and expected behaviors.

  • Build and maintain Playwright UI suites and REST Assured API frameworks; standardize patterns, utilities, fixtures, and test data management for reuse across teams.

  • Embed smoke, regression, and non-functional checks into automated CI/CD pipelines (gating, parallelization, flaky-test management, artifacting ) to ensure predictable, fast feedback.

  • Use SQL to validate audit data transformations, reconcile service responses to source of truth, and codify data-quality assertions in automation suites.

  • Incorporate Premium Audit domain rules (documents, exposures, triage paths) into test scenarios to maximize defect prevention and business accuracy.

  • Partner with engineers and BAs to define acceptance criteria, add test hooks/telemetry, and adopt TDD/BDD where valuable.

  • Collaborate on performance, resilience, and security checks aligned with enterprise standards and platform SLIs/SLOs.

  • Improve test observability (logs, traces, metrics), triage pipeline failures quickly, and drive continuous improvement of flakiness, coverage, and mean-time-to-detect.

Required Skills Experience

  • 1 - 2 years in SDET /SWE roles with a strong track record building test automation for cloud-native, microservices-based systems.

  • Exper ience with Playwright and Karate for UI and REST Assured for API automation; hands-on with Postman for exploratory/API validation.

  • Proven experience integrating automated test suites into enterprise CI/CD pipelines, including parallel execution, environment configuration, artifacts, and test-data seeding.

  • Strong coding skills (e.g., TypeScript/Java) with clean test-code design, use of fixtures/mocks, dependency injection, and maintainable framework patterns.

  • Comfortable writing complex SQL for verification, reconciliation, and data-quality checks across transactional and analytical stores.

  • Solid understanding of REST APIs , event-driven architectures, workflow/rules engines, and integration testing at system boundaries.

  • Experience contributing to backlog refinement, definition of done, and iterative delivery within Agile/SAFe teams.

  • Ability to map test scenarios to Premium Audit processes and financial/insurance operational controls.

  • Familiarity with AWS-based delivery, containerized runners, and pipeline tooling such as Jenkins or Azure DevOps.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with performance testing (e.g., k6, Gatling, JMeter ), chaos/resilience checks, and tuning within CI.

  • Experience with service virtualization , synthetic data generation, and privacy-aware test data management.

  • Awareness of OWASP-aligned security testing practices and collaboration with AppSec to automate baseline security validations.

  • Working knowledge of PC / Premium Audit workflows (documents, exposure/classification logic, audit review paths)

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on advanced cloud automation and AI technologies.

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.

  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.

  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.

About Us: Paytm is Indias leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. About the team: QR - QR is one of Paytm s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their businessthrough simplicity and data-driven technology.

Role Overview
We are looking for an energetic and customer-focused Key Account Manager to manage andgrow relationships with key merchants. The ideal candidate will be responsible for drivingmerchant engagement, increasing payment acceptance, growing GMV, and identifyingopportunities to cross-sell payment solutions.

Key Responsibilities Manage a portfolio of key merchant accounts and build long-term relationships.
Drive merchant activation, engagement, and business growth.
Increase GMV and payment volumes across UPI, QR, Soundbox, and EDC.
Identify opportunities to cross-sell products such as Soundbox, EDC, Merchant Loans,Insurance, and other value-added services.
Conduct regular business reviews with merchants and recommend growth opportunities
. Coordinate with internal teams to resolve merchant issues quickly.
Monitor merchant performance and work to improve retention and reduce churn.
Track competition and market trends to identify new business opportunities.
Achieve monthly sales, revenue, and activation targets.

Eligibility
Graduate in any discipline (MBA is an added advantage).
1-4 years of experience in Key Account Management, B2B Sales, FinTech, Banking,Payments, Telecom, or FMCG.
Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
Ability to analyze merchant performance and identify growth opportunities
Comfortable working in a target-driven environment. Proficient in MS Excel and CRM tools.

Preferred Skills
Experience in merchant acquiring or digital payments.
Understanding of UPI, QR, POS/EDC, and Soundbox solutions.
Excellent problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.

GMV Growth
Merchant Activation
Active Merchant Rate
Cross-sell Revenue
Merchant Retention

Work with one of India s leading digital payments ecosystems.
Fast-paced learning environment with strong career growth opportunities.
Performance-driven culture with attractive incentives

jobDescription:
Role Summary

The Implementation Analyst I role is responsible for developing, configuring, testing, and supporting chatbot and workflow automation solutions using low-code platforms. The role focuses on implementing business requirements through chatbot development, workflow automation, and API integrations while ensuring solution quality and adherence to best practices.

The ideal candidate should possess a strong mix of:

  • Chatbot and workflow development
  • Low-code platform knowledge (Chatlayer, Node-RED or similar)
  • API integration and troubleshooting
  • Problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Learning mindset and technical curiosity

Key Responsibilities

Chatbot & Workflow Development

  • Design and develop automation workflows and chatbot solutions using Chatlayer, Node-RED, or similar low-code platforms.
  • Configure, develop, test, and deploy chatbot solutions based on business requirements.
  • Implement conversational flows, business logic, and workflow automation.
  • Support enhancements and maintenance of existing chatbot implementations.

Automation & Integration

  • Develop and integrate chatbot workflows with REST (JSON) and SOAP APIs.
  • Configure third-party system integrations using APIs.
  • Assist in implementing workflow automation to improve business processes.
  • Perform API testing and troubleshoot integration-related issues.

Testing & Support

  • Perform functional testing and quality assurance of chatbot and workflow solutions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve workflow, chatbot, and integration issues.
  • Ensure chatbot implementations comply with security and data protection guidelines.
  • Provide production support and bug fixes for deployed solutions.

Documentation & Process

  • Prepare workflow documentation and implementation guides.
  • Follow coding standards and implementation best practices.
  • Continuously learn new automation technologies and contribute to process improvements.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related engineering discipline.

Experience

  • 1 to 3 years of experience in chatbot development, workflow automation, low-code platforms, or application development.

Required Skills & Knowledge

  • Experience with Chatlayer, Node-RED, Power Automate, or similar automation platforms.
  • Experience developing chatbot solutions from design through deployment.
  • Good understanding of workflow design and automation concepts.
  • Basic knowledge of REST (JSON) and SOAP API integrations.
  • Understanding of third-party API integration concepts.
  • Basic knowledge of Python.
  • Basic understanding of relational databases and SQL.
  • Knowledge of JavaScript fundamentals.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.
  • Ability to learn new technologies and adapt to changing priorities.

Preferred Skills

  • Familiarity with Active Directory (AD), LDAP, SAML, Single Sign-On (SSO), Identity Management (IDM), SSL/TLS, PKI, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, and URI concepts.
  • Exposure to chatbot platforms, conversational AI, or workflow automation tools.
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and testing practices.
  • Exposure to enterprise application integrations will be an added advantage.

In this role, you will be responsible for leading automation activities, developing and maintaining automation scripts, and ensuring the quality and stability of our products through comprehensive testing strategies.

You will play a pivotal role in validating the entire Amadeus product ecosystem by running end-to-end tests, managing defect life cycles, and ensuring smooth delivery of releases before production. You will also collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Application Development, Product Management, and DevOps, to achieve optimal product performance.

Key Responsibilities:
Test Strategy and Planning:
Participate in specification and architecture reviews, including customer specification reviews, to identify potential risks, gaps, and issues.
Define comprehensive test strategies and plans, incorporating both functional and non-functional test cases, ensuring traceability with specifications and customer requirements.
Ensure adherence to CI/CD, Green IT, and all relevant quality guidelines, including SDL, STDL, and industry standards (ISTQB).
Test Expertise:
Design test cases, write test scripts, and execute tests in alignment with the test strategy.
Prepare and manage test environments, data, and perform execution of test cases.
Provide sign-offs (go/no-go) on features based on exit criteria.
Continuously assess the need to add, update, or remove test cases in the regression and CI/CD pipelines.
Investigate and test fixes for PTRs, maintaining and enriching test suites.
Test Automation:
Develop and maintain automation frameworks and scripts using Java, Selenium, Groovy, TypeScript, and Python.
Conduct peer reviews of automation scripts to ensure adherence to quality standards.
Collaborate with functional teams to maintain a strong understanding of the product ecosystem and develop relevant test scenarios.
Influence functional teams to improve test coverage and ensure comprehensive business scenarios.
Lead daily automated test campaigns, analyzing results, identifying defects, and collaborating with developers for resolution.

Defect Management:
Open, manage, and track defects, assigning appropriate severity levels based on issue impact.
Perform defect validation, providing go/no-go decisions for production deployments based on fixes.
Provide detailed defect reports and track resolution progress.
DevOps:
Proactively maintain Linux infrastructure to ensure 24/7 uptime and support for the operating system platform.
Troubleshoot and resolve system issues, continuously improving processes.
Support migration to the cloud and manage RedHat Linux systems administration solutions.
Implement and maintain operational tools for deployment, monitoring, and analysis of public cloud infrastructure.
Ensure CI/CD solutions are implemented and functioning as expected.
Engage in system troubleshooting and issue resolution across platforms and applications.
Tools and Technologies:
Selenium, Java, Groovy, Geb, Spock (BDD Framework)
Playwright TypeScript Python
Jenkins, CI/CD pipelines
Octane/ALM, Postman, SOAP UI, Webservices
Docker, Containers, Kubernetes
RedHat Linux Systems Administration
Public cloud infrastructure provisioning and management (defined as code)

Qualifications:
Proven experience in test automation with strong skills in Java, Selenium, Groovy, TypeScript, and Python.
In-depth understanding of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Solid experience in Linux systems administration, particularly with RedHat and related technologies.
Familiarity with BDD frameworks like Spock and Geb.
Expertise in end-to-end testing and test automation practices, including regression testing and performance testing.
Strong experience in defect management and maintaining high-quality standards in production environments.
Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
Knowledge of the travel domain is a plus.
Familiarity with AI/ML concepts is an added advantage.

AI Engineer - Customer Success Services (F5)

As F5 scales its SaaS and subscription offerings, intelligent automation and AI-driven experiences across support and success workflows are mission-critical. The AI Engineer will design, build, and operate the core ML/AI systems that power self-service, agent assist, knowledge automation, routing, summarization, and safety/observability tooling, delivering measurable improvements in CSAT, deflection, MTTR and agent productivity.

Position summary

You will lead the technical vision and delivery for AI systems across the Customer Success Support portfolio (myF5, case management, knowledge, omni-channel). You'll translate product needs into robust machine learning architectures, own model lifecycle and MLOps, implement safe RAG/LLM systems and observability, and partner closely with Product, Support Ops, Security/Compliance, and external vendor platforms to ship production-grade solutions. You are both a hands-on engineer able to deliver production code and an influencer who mentors engineers and sets engineering standards.

  • Define technical architecture and roadmap for AI capabilities in support workflows: retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), LLM-based assistants, intent classification, summarization, knowledge generation/maintenance, and conversational systems.
  • Lead end-to-end model lifecycle: data pipelines, training, evaluation, fine-tuning, validation, deployment, and continuous monitoring (MLOps).
  • Build and operate production-quality ML services and APIs (scalable inference, caching, batching, latency SLAs); write performant, well-tested code (primarily Python).
  • Design and implement safety, privacy, and governance controls for generative systems: hallucination mitigation, provenance/explainability, access control, logging/audit, and data protection (including FedRAMP/GovCloud considerations where required).
  • Full-Stack Development: Design, develop, and maintain scalable systems, combining frontend development using React/Next.js with TypeScript and backend development with Java (Spring Boot, Hibernate) and additional backend languages like Node, Python, or Go.
  • Backend Expertise with Java: Build high-performance, scalable backend systems using modern Java frameworks (Spring Boot, Hibernate). Ensure APIs, microservices, and integrations are robust, efficient, and secure.
  • Cloud Services: Implement and maintain cloud-native applications on Azure or AWS, leveraging managed services such as computing, networking, databases (e.g., Postgres, DynamoDB, Cosmos DB), and object storage (e.g., S3, Azure Blob).
  • Proficient in implementing robust testing strategies for Java applications using frameworks such as JUnit, TestNG, Mockito, Selenium, and Cucumber.
  • Event-Driven Architecture: Design and implement event-driven systems using tools such as Solace, Kafka, or AWS SNS/SQS, ensuring real-time communication and asynchronous workflows.
  • DevOps CI/CD: Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines with tools like GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins, streamlining deployment processes.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Utilize IaC tools like Terraform, ARM, or Bicep to manage cloud configurations and provision reliable infrastructure.
  • Containerization Orchestration: Develop and deploy scalable containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes (e.g., AKS/EKS).
  • Integrate AI components with platform systems (Salesforce Service Cloud / Experience Cloud, myF5 portal, search engines like Coveo), and with Azure/AWS cloud services and data platforms.
  • Instrument KPIs and observability for AI features (deflection rate, CSAT impact, SLA compliance, model accuracy, latency, drift); use metrics to drive iterations.
  • Prototype, experiment, and evaluate new models and approaches; maintain a research product mindset to bring practical, timely AI to production.
  • Coach and mentor engineers and data scientists; set best practices for reproducible experiments, feature engineering, model tests, and CI/CD for models.

jobDescription:

Prepare and validate datasets from multiple sources (transactions, bureau, device/digital, documents,

Implement features engineering pipelines (aggregations, ratios, behavior signals) and maintain feature

definitions.


Build large-scale ML systems: distributed training pipelines, feature stores, model registry, CI/CD for ML, and

scalable batch + near-real-time scoring services.


Support embedding workflows (text/customer/device/dealer/geo) including batch refresh, versioning, and

lineage.

Execute training/inference jobs using established frameworks, log experiments and outcomes.

Perform error analysis, data leakage checks, and basic model monitoring (drift signals, data anomalies)

Contribute to deployment readiness: tests, reproducible configs, and incident triage support.

Assist document processing: chunking, cleaning, metadata tagging, indexing access filters.

Maintain prompt/context templates, grounding rules, and evaluation sets for RAG/LLM assistants used by

Pods.

Run offline evaluations (retrieval quality, answer quality, regressions) and track metrics across releases.

5) Engineering Hygiene Governance

Write clean, testable code; follow Git workflows and CI checks.

Maintain documentation: dataset cards, feature notes, pipeline SOPs, and release checklists.

Follow security/privacy controls for regulated data, ensuring traceability and auditability.

Bachelors/Masters in CS/Math/Engineering

production grade ML system at scale.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Role Description:
The Corporate Audit Senior Associate will report to the Corporate Audit Senior Manager. The Audit Senior Associate will assist the Chief Audit Executives, Director, Senior Managers and Staff of Amgen Corporate Audit in providing independent, objective assurance and consulting services.
The Corporate Audit Senior Associate will support with International, functional and Healthcare compliance audits by analyzing data to identify higher risk transactions; perform sample selection for the audits and to test transactions to determine if the companys system of risk management, control and governance processes are adequate and functioning in a manner appropriate to a company of Amgens size and market.

  • Strong program management and execution skills
  • Ability to translate business needs into scalable data solutions
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

This role is critical to advancing AuRA as a scalable, AI-ready data enablement layer within Neural Nexus, enabling:

ABOUT AMGEN
Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the worlds toughest diseases, and make peoples lives easier, fuller and longer. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond whats known today.
ABOUT THE ROLE
Amgen is seeking an Associate Scientist to help advance discovery chemistry through the application of agentic AI. This role sits at the intersection of medicinal chemistry, computational science, with a focus on developing and applying AI-enabled workflows that accelerate molecular design, scientific data interpretation, and research decision-making.
The ideal candidate will hold a Masters degree in Chemistry or a related discipline, bring a strong scientific foundation, and preferably have relevant pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO, or other industry research experience. A PhD is not required.

  • Organize, curate, and assess chemical, biological, and assay data to support reliable AI-enabled analysis and decision-making.
  • Evaluate AI-generated outputs for scientific validity, relevance, reproducibility, and practical value in discovery chemistry programs.
  • Translate scientific questions and laboratory needs into structured workflows, prompts, evaluation approaches, and usable tools.
  • Support adoption of agentic AI tools within discovery chemistry teams while maintaining rigorous standards for data integrity, documentation, confidentiality, and scientific quality.
  • Work with laboratory scientists to incorporate experimental results and user feedback into iterative workflow and tool improvements.
  • Contribute to the development of best practices for the appropriate use of generative AI and agentic systems in research.
  • Stay current with advances in AI, cheminformatics, laboratory automation, and computational drug discovery.
  • Communicate results, workflow performance, and recommendations clearly to cross-functional scientific stakeholders.
Basic Qualifications
  • Masters degree in Chemistry, Medicinal Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical Biology, Computational Chemistry, Data Science, or a closely related scientific field.
  • Strong understanding of small-molecule discovery, organic synthesis, medicinal chemistry, analytical chemistry, or an allied area.
  • Experience working with scientific data, including chemical structures, reaction data, assay data, or experimental results.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze problems systematically, document work clearly, and maintain high standards of scientific rigor.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional research environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

jobDescription:
About the Role

  • We are looking for a visionary AI Video Artist who is not just a prompter, but a true technical creator.
  • You sit at the intersection of Visual Effects (VFX), Game Engines, and Generative AI.
  • You will be responsible for creating hyper-realistic, cinematic video content by blending traditional compositing tools with state-of-the-art AI platforms.
  • We don't just want "AI videos"we want production-grade realism.
  • You must understand lighting, camera movement, and consistency, using AI as a power tool to accelerate high-end workflows.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Creation: Conceptualize and produce high-fidelity video content using a hybrid workflow of AI generation and manual VFX polishing.
  • Advanced AI Prompting: Utilize tools like Runway (Gen-3), Kling, Midjourney, and Sora/Veo to generate base assets with precise camera control and character consistency.
  • VFX & Compositing: Take AI-generated raw footage and refine it using After Effects, Nuke, or DaVinci Resolve.
  • Fix artifacts, handle color grading, and ensure temporal stability (no "flickering").
  • 3D & Gaming Integration: Work with Unreal Engine 5 or Blender to create realistic environments and integrate digital avatars if required.
  • Character Consistency: Train or fine-tune models (LoRAs/ControlNet) to ensure characters look exactly the same across different shots and angles.
  • R&D: Stay updated daily on the newest AI tools.
  • If a new model drops on Hugging Face or GitHub, you should be the first to test it.

Required Skills & Toolset 1.

  • The "Real" Tech Stack (Non-Negotiable): VFX/Editing: Mastery of Adobe After Effects (Compositing, Roto), Premiere Pro, and DaVinci Resolve (Color Grading).
  • 3D Basics: Familiarity with Blender or Unreal Engine (Camera setting, Lighting, Environment design).
  • The AI Stack (Deep Knowledge Required): Video Gen: Runway Gen-3 Alpha, Kling AI, Luma Dream Machine, or Haiper.
  • Image Gen: Midjourney v6 (Advanced Parameters), Stable Diffusion (ComfyUI workflows are a huge plus).
  • Lip-Sync & Voice: ElevenLabs, HeyGen, or LivePortrait.
  • Optimization: Topaz Video AI (Upscaling) and interpolation tools.
  • Soft Skills: "Director's Eye": You understand cinematographyfocal lengths, shutter angles, lighting setups (Rim light, Key light), and composition.
  • Problem Solving: AI makes mistakes.
  • You must know how to fix "weird hands" or "glitchy eyes" manually in post-production.

Nice-to-Have (Bonus Points)

  • Experience in the Gaming Industry (Level Design, Cinematics, or Character Rigging).
  • Knowledge of ComfyUI Node systems for complex Stable Diffusion workflows.
  • Experience with Python scripting for automating media workflows.
  • Background in traditional art or photography.
  • Who You Are You don't just type "Make a cool video" into ChatGPT.
  • You write detailed prompts like "Cinematic wide shot, 35mm lens, volumetric lighting, cyberpunk street, unreal engine 5 render style --ar 16:9".
  • You are frustrated when AI video looks "wobbly" and you know exactly how to stabilize it.
  • You have an open mindset: You are willing to relearn your workflow every month as technology changes.
  • Submission Requirement Please do not send just a CV.
  • You must share a Portfolio or Showreel demonstrating: AI-Generated Video work (mentioning the tools used).
  • Any VFX breakdowns (Before/After) showing how you fixed/improved raw AI output.

This is not simply an IT support or ChatGPT-based role. We are looking for someone who is genuinely passionate about AI, automation and emerging technology and wants to become deeply involved in helping us build an AI-enabled organisation.

You will work closely with senior management, learn how different areas of the company operate, identify opportunities for improvement and develop practical AI and automation solutions that improve efficiency, education, administration, marketing, customer experience and overall business performance.

  • Implementing RAG, semantic search, embeddings, vector databases and knowledge-management solutions.

  • Supporting AI integration within CRM, customer service, admissions and communication systems.
  • Developing marketing, content and social-media automations.
  • Exploring AI-powered voice, telephone and conversational systems.
  • Exploring AI-generated images, audio, video, avatars and multimedia.
  • Investigating computer-use agents capable of interacting with browsers and software.
  • Exploring multimodal AI capable of understanding text, images, documents, audio and video.
  • Evaluating open-source, cloud-based, local and private AI models.
  • Exploring model customisation, fine-tuning and domain-specific AI where appropriate.
  • Monitoring the accuracy, reliability and performance of AI systems.
  • Developing AI evaluation and quality-assurance processes.
  • Maintaining appropriate human review for important AI-generated outputs.
  • Evaluating AI costs, subscriptions, API usage and return on investment.
  • Supporting AI security, privacy, GDPR, safeguarding and governance requirements.
  • Training staff in the effective and responsible use of AI.
  • Creating internal AI procedures, documentation and best-practice guidelines.
  • Monitoring developments within the global AI industry and recommending technologies the organisation should investigate.
  • Developing and maintaining a longer-term AI Transformation Roadmap for the organisation.

You are not expected to be an expert in every area.

What matters is your ability to learn rapidly, investigate unfamiliar technologies, experiment intelligently and turn promising ideas into practical solutions.


AI in Education

As an education organisation, a major part of our AI strategy will involve exploring how technology can improve teaching and learning.


Projects may include:

  • AI tutoring systems
  • Personalised and adaptive learning
  • Intelligent question generation
  • Assessment creation

  • Passionate about AI and emerging technology.

  • Highly organised.

  • Persistent when solving difficult problems.
  • Focused on practical outcomes rather than technology for technology's sake.
  • Excited by the rapid development of AI.

Most importantly, you must genuinely enjoy learning.

AI is developing too quickly for anyone to rely solely on what they already know.

Take Ownership

We are not looking for somebody who simply waits to be given individual tasks.

We want somebody whose approach is:

Explore Identify Research Design Build Test Validate Implement Measure Improve

You should be willing to examine an existing process and ask:

"Is there a better way of doing this, and can AI or automation help us achieve it?"

You will be encouraged to research technologies, propose ideas, build prototypes, test solutions and take successful projects through to implementation.

Full-Time Commitment

This is a full-time role requiring significant commitment and engagement with the organisation during and alongside our normal company operating hours.

We are looking for someone who wants to become an integral and long-term part of the organisation rather than simply providing occasional AI consultancy.

The successful candidate will be expected to continually learn and develop as AI technology evolves.


Learning & Career Development

This position offers significant scope for professional development.

You will have opportunities to:

  • Research emerging AI technologies.
  • Experiment with new platforms.
  • Develop real-world AI solutions.
  • Build AI agents and automated systems.
  • Design and develop business intelligence and management dashboards.
  • Work directly with senior management.
  • Gain experience across multiple business functions.

  • Train and support colleagues.
  • Develop specialist technical expertise.
  • Build a substantial portfolio of practical AI implementations.
  • Progress as the organisation's AI capabilities expand.

Initially, you will learn how our organisation operates and identify opportunities where AI and automation can make an immediate difference.


You will then help develop an AI Transformation Roadmap, covering:

  • Immediate opportunities and quick wins
  • Automation opportunities
  • Medium-term AI projects
  • Strategic AI initiatives
  • Educational AI development
  • System integrations
  • Management dashboards and business intelligence
  • Centralised data and reporting
  • Productivity improvements
  • Cost-saving opportunities
  • New products and services
  • Security and governance
  • Future technology requirements

Projects should be assessed according to:

Business Impact Feasibility Cost Risk Scalability

Ultimately, your work should help us:

Reduce Administration Increase Productivity Improve Quality Personalise Learning Improve Customer Experience Improve Decision-Making Improve Data Visibility Reduce Costs Develop New Capabilities Create New Opportunities


How to Apply

Please submit your CV and covering letter explaining:

  1. Your practical experience with AI and automation.
  2. Which AI platforms, models and technologies you have worked with.
  3. Examples of AI systems, agents, automations or applications you have personally developed.
  4. Your experience with APIs and software integrations.
  5. Your coding/programming experience.
  6. Your experience creating dashboards, business intelligence systems or data visualisations, including the platforms you have used.
  7. An example of a business process you have automated or significantly improved.
  8. Which area of AI currently interests you most and why.
  9. What AI technologies you are currently learning.
  10. Where you believe AI is heading over the next 35 years.
  11. How you believe AI could transform a growing education organisation.
  12. What you would investigate during your first 30 days in this position.
  13. Links to any relevant GitHub repositories, portfolios, dashboards, demonstrations, applications or projects you have developed.

Please also answer the following question:

"If you were given responsibility for transforming our organisation through AI, what are the first three areas you would investigate, and why?"

We are looking for someone who doesn't just want a job in AI. We want someone who wants to continuously learn, build, experiment and ultimately help us create an AI-enabled organisation.

If you are ambitious, technically curious and excited about where Artificial Intelligence is heading, we would love to hear from you.

title: FinCrime Compliance - Staff
jobDescription:
Job Summary

The Compliance team at EY GDS partners with other EY offices across the globe to provide an array of compliance solutions to our clients. The team works on short to long term engagements to assist in establishing, maintaining, and reviewing the outputs of business functions and compliance programs.

Financial crime risks relating to anti-money laundering (AML), terrorist financing, anti-bribery controls, sanctions compliance and fraud are a high focus for regulated businesses and external scrutiny as regulation and practice continues to evolve. Responsible for developing and overseeing the financial crime and fraud prevention framework, designed to ensure client(s) are compliant, protected from risk and loss from financial crime.

The Opportunity

As a part of our Global Managed Services Delivery team, you will be working with EY offices across the globe to provide an array of compliance solutions to our clients. The team works on short to long term engagements to provide assistance in establishing, maintaining and reviewing the outputs of business functions and compliance programs.

Our Financial Crime Consulting team consists of hundreds of professionals who advise and drive change for the firms banking, capital markets, insurance, and asset management clients in Financial Crime. Our Financial Crime Consulting team specializes in several areas, including:

  • AML transaction monitoring
  • SAR drafting
  • Fraud Investigation
  • Crypto investigation
  • Customer screening
  • Payment screening filtering for Sanctions, PEPs and adverse media
  • KYC Remediation
  • Compliance testing and FATCA
  • Financial crime risk assessment reviews
  • AI Tools Automation

Key Responsibilities

As a Financial Crime Compliance Analyst, you will predominantly support the compliance team in the financial crime space. You will help businesses comply with financial crime regulations and adhere to relevant client(s) policies and procedures related to anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing.

  • Multi-tasker, learn on the job and work to meet strict deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Devising process documentation and translating complex processes into easy-to-follow instructions
  • Coordinating efforts with internal stakeholders as appropriate
  • Work as a member of a team to ensure operational readiness of applications and processes required to conduct AML program requirements
  • Seek to understand the overall process and objective before beginning to work on a task
  • Escalate issues and problems, articulate clearly to leadership, onshore and client team
  • Demonstrate integrity, respect and be able to work collaboratively with team members
  • Apply AI tools and automation techniques to support financial crime compliance workstreams.

Proficiency in Transaction Monitoring Space

  • Customer transactions: Oversee transactions, including transfers, deposits, and withdrawals, to identify suspicious activity
  • Customer Information Review: Assess historical and current customer data and interactions to detect potential financial crime risks
  • Suspicious Activity Reporting (SARs): Investigate and report suspicious activity, including Anti-Money Laundering (AML) concerns, for assigned business units
  • In-depth understanding of Transaction monitoring and risks in each Segment:
    • Wealth Management Risk: Familiarity with the unique risks associated with wealth management, such as high-net-worth client transactions and complex financial instruments
    • Commercial Banking Transactions: An understanding of the risks inherent in commercial banking transactions, including due diligence requirements for loan transactions, deposits, and trade finance activities
    • Corporate Transaction Monitoring: Knowledge of the process for monitoring corporate client transactions, identifying potential risks in business accounts, and ensuring compliance with relevant regulations
    • Correspondent Banking Risk Detection: Familiarity with the risks associated with correspondent banking relationships, including cross-border transactions, and ensuring compliance with international AML standards

Skills and Attributes for Success

  • Time management skills to be able to manage deadlines effectively
  • Exhibit analytical skills and attention to detail while maintaining a holistic view and logical thinking
  • Demonstrate working knowledge of AI-enabled tools and technologies to improve research, analysis, investigation quality and operational efficiency.
  • Proficiency in Generative AI and prompt engineering, with the ability to design effective prompts and leverage AI tools to enhance research, analysis, problem-solving, and operational efficiency.

To qualify for the role, you must have

  • Bachelors / Master s degree in finance, accounting, economics, law, or a related field
  • 1-3 years of work experience in AML Transaction Monitoring
  • Demonstrated experience in a consulting role or within a large corporate environment, with a strong understanding of global Financial Crime Compliance practices
  • Good understanding of SAR drafting and AML regulatory reporting.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret complex financial data
  • Good understanding of banking industry, its products, and services
  • Experience analysing financial/bank statements
  • Experience in interpreting policy documents
  • Willingness to work from office; 5 days a week
  • Willingness to work on Indian Holidays as per client requirement
  • Willingness to work in shifts, if required
  • Willingness to travel, within the country and internationally as required

Position: AI Data Annotator – Sports Video & Image Annotation
Project: American Football Data Annotation
Experience: 0–2 years
Location: India / Remote
Employment Type: Contract – 3.5 Months
Project Start: Immediate / This Week
Working Hours: As per project requirement

Job Summary

We are looking for AI Data Annotators to support an immediate project involving images and video frames from American Football games. The role will involve detailed annotation of sports footage, including key-point marking, player/object identification, and other image/video annotation workflows to create high-quality training data for AI and computer vision models.

The project will have approximately 7 annotation workflows, and selected candidates will receive project-specific training and guidelines.

Key Responsibilities

  • Annotate images and video frames from American Football games.
  • Mark key points/key landmarks accurately according to project guidelines.
  • Identify and annotate players, objects and other relevant elements in video frames.
  • Perform frame-by-frame annotation and maintain consistency across consecutive frames.
  • Follow defined annotation guidelines and workflow instructions.
  • Review completed annotations and correct errors where required.
  • Maintain required accuracy and productivity/quality benchmarks.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions and feedback discussions.
  • Escalate unclear or ambiguous cases to the QA/Team Lead.
  • Ensure timely completion of assigned annotation volumes.

Required Skills

  • Good attention to detail and ability to perform repetitive visual tasks accurately.
  • Comfortable working with images and video frames.
  • Basic computer proficiency and ability to learn annotation tools quickly.
  • Good English comprehension.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions and annotation guidelines.
  • Good typing and computer navigation skills.
  • Willingness to work on a short-term project for approximately 3.5 months.

Preferred Skills

  • Prior experience in data annotation / image annotation / video annotation.
  • Experience with tools such as CVAT, Labelbox, Supervisely, Scale AI or similar platforms.
  • Experience with key-point annotation, bounding boxes, polygons or object tracking.
  • Previous experience working on sports/sports-video annotation projects.
  • Knowledge of American Football/NFL will be an advantage but is not mandatory.

Candidate Profile

We are particularly interested in candidates who are:

  • Detail-oriented
  • Comfortable watching and analyzing sports videos
  • Fast learners
  • Consistent with repetitive annotation tasks
  • Able to meet productivity and accuracy targets
  • Available to join immediately

Project Details

  • Project Duration: Approximately 3.5 months
  • Start Date: Immediate / expected to start this week
  • Work Type: Image & Video Frame Annotation
  • Workflows: Approximately 7
  • Domain: American Football / Sports
  • Annotation Type: Key points and other visual annotations
  • Training: Project-specific training will be provided
  • Experience: Freshers with strong visual attention can also be considered

Suggested Screening Criteria

For quick hiring, I would screen candidates on:

  1. Visual attention test
  2. Key-point annotation accuracy
  3. Ability to understand annotation guidelines
  4. Speed/productivity
  5. Basic English comprehension
  6. Ability to identify players/objects in sports footage
  7. Availability for the full 3.5-month project
  8. Willingness to work according to the required shift/timings
