title: Associate TSE II
jobDescription:
Job Summary
MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their exceptional problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB problems. Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem - database server, drivers, cloud and infrastructure. This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork and a great sense of humor to help our customers to be successful with MongoDB.
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
Responsibilities
You''ll be working alongside our largest customers, solving their complex challenges - resolving questions on architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between. You''ll be an expert resource on best practices in running MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You''ll be an advocate for customers'' needs - interfacing with our product management and development teams on their behalf. And you''ll contribute to internal projects, including software development of support tools for performance, benchmarking, and diagnostics.
Requirements
  • 4+ years of relevant experience
  • Strong understanding and grasp of the following areas
  • Systems administration
  • Troubleshooting Systems
  • Scalable and Highly available distributed systems
  • Network Administration
  • Application Architecture
  • Data architecture and design
  • Understanding of database architecture and administration
  • Experience in performance tuning and benchmarking
  • Previous experience in technical support
  • A B.Tech / B.S. or equivalent work experience
Nice to have
  • Comfortable with modern AI concepts and proficient in using AI-assisted tools to accelerate troubleshooting and enhance day-to-day technical support workflows.
  • Knowledge on one or more of Java, Python, Ruby, C, C++, C#, Javascript, node.js, Go, PHP, or Perl
Its crucial for every candidate that they can check off all of these boxes
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Genuine desire to help people
  • Uncontrollable urge to investigate and solve problems, with advanced diagnostic and troubleshooting skills
  • Ability to think on your feet, remain calm under pressure and solve problems in real-time
  • Desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills
  • Strong teamwork: willingness and ability to get help from team members when required, and the good judgment to know when to seek help
Success Measures
  • In 3 months, youll have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its ecosystem. You will complete New Hire Training.
  • In 6 months, you will be comfortable working frontline with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam.
  • In 12 months, you will work on gaining expertise to be a part of a technical experts group within the MongoDB ecosystem and will be helping your peer engineers in advance diagnostics. Also, you will be encouraged to handle technical escalations independently.

Job Summary

Insurity's Next Interfaces Administrator will be the go-to specialist for our AI-enabled integrations and automations, ensuring critical workflows, agents, and data flows run reliably every day. You'll monitor and troubleshoot interfaces and AI agents, document and improve runbooks, and turn business needs into practical automations using tools like Copilot/Claude and Python or PowerShell. Partnering with Cloud Operations you'll coordinate the AI agent lifecycle from intake and prioritization through testing, rollout, and continuous optimization so our teams can work smarter and faster.

Insurity's Next Interfaces Administrator

What Our Interfaces Administrator Will Do

  • Support existing integration solutions and assigned AI-enabled automations or agents by being able to troubleshoot, investigate, and identify issues.
  • Work with services and orchestrations to investigate support for failed jobs and approved AI / automation jobs where applicable.
  • Create supporting document for integration failures and integration processes, and AI agent support procedures where required.
  • Perform daily monitoring of batch jobs and assigned AI agents / automation workflows to make sure all jobs process normally.
  • Elicit integration requirements from the business, leading requirements gathering meetings where necessary, and identify AI automation opportunities where applicable.
  • Analyze the requirements to determine the system needs to fulfill those requirements, including any AI tool, data, or knowledge source dependencies where applicable.
  • Prepare integration use cases and leading walkthroughs to validate the documentation, including AI-assisted workflow use cases where required.
  • Provide 24x7 on call support for automation processes.
  • Manage file transfer permissions and use it as part of batch integration jobs.
  • Set-up and maintain PGP encryption keys with customers.
  • Code automation jobs in JavaScript, Python, or PowerShell where appropriate.
  • Track assigned AI agent or automation work items, support stakeholder follow-up, and help unblock rollout dependencies where required.
  • Stay up to date on industry and job-related trends and best practices, including AI, prompt usage, and automation best practices.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for someone with 1 year of experience in a 24x7 high-availability production environment. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, technically curious, comfortable with Python or PowerShell, and confident using tools like ChatGPT or Claude to support prompts, research, and light AI-enabled work. They should be organized, dependable, and effective at coordinating with stakeholders to keep actions moving.

Key Skills

  • Active listening
  • Analytical and critical thinking
  • Self-starter and quick learner
  • Detail oriented
  • Ability to collaborate and work independently
  • Written and oral English communication
  • Time management including work planning, prioritization, and organization
  • Sound judgement
  • Ability to handle multiple priorities and/or tasks

Job Summary

Were looking for a Social Media Organic Growth Specialist to build and scale our organic brand presence across social media platforms and YouTube. This is a hands-on role for someone who understands social-first storytelling, internet culture, content strategy, and community building.

Beyond creating engaging content, youll be responsible for developing content IPs (recurring formats, series, and shows) that audiences recognize, return to, and share. Youll also leverage your understanding of SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and Online Reputation Management (ORM) to ensure every piece of content strengthens the brands visibility across search engines, AI answer platforms, and online conversations.

Your primary focus will be organic growth driving reach, engagement, brand awareness, and audience loyalty without relying heavily on paid media.

Key Responsibilities

  • Social Media Organic Growth
    • Own the day-to-day management of the brands social media channels, including Instagram, LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and emerging platforms.
    • Develop and execute content calendars aligned with business, marketing, and brand objectives.
    • Create, curate, and publish engaging content across formats including posts, carousels, reels, stories, shorts, and videos.
    • Produce content designed to earn organic reach, engagement, and shares rather than simply maintaining a posting schedule.
    • Stay on top of platform trends, memes, creator formats, and algorithm updates, adapting them creatively while maintaining the brand voice.
    • Write compelling, platform-native copy and captions.
    • Build and nurture an active community by responding to comments, messages, and conversations in a timely and authentic manner.
  • YouTube Growth Content IP Development
    • Own and grow the brands YouTube presence across both long-form content and Shorts.
    • Conceptualize, launch, and scale recurring content IPs, series, and shows that build audience loyalty and brand recall.
    • Collaborate with presenters, editors, designers, and production teams to maintain consistency in quality, publishing cadence, and format identity.
    • Optimize titles, thumbnails, descriptions, chapters, and metadata to maximize discoverability and audience retention.
    • Analyze content performance to identify winning formats, double down on successful content, and continuously iterate on underperforming concepts.
  • SEO, AEO Search Visibility
    • Apply SEO and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) best practices across social and video content to improve discoverability on Google Search, YouTube, Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other AI-powered search experiences.
    • Optimize metadata, descriptions, keywords, transcripts, and content structure for long-term organic visibility.
    • Collaborate with the SEO and Content teams to align social content with strategic keyword and topic priorities.
  • Online Reputation Management (ORM)
    • Monitor conversations and public sentiment across social platforms, Reddit, Quora, review sites, and community forums.
    • Identify emerging negative narratives or reputation risks and escalate them to the appropriate stakeholders.
    • Ensure organic content consistently reinforces an authentic, trustworthy, and positive brand narrative.
    • Support initiatives that improve brand perception and strengthen online credibility.
  • Organic Growth Strategy Reporting
    • Track and report key organic performance metrics including:
      • Reach
      • Engagement
      • Follower growth
      • Share of Voice
      • Watch time
      • Audience retention
      • YouTube channel performance
    • Run structured content experiments with clear hypotheses, success metrics, and documented learnings.
    • Develop repeatable playbooks around high-performing formats and growth strategies.
    • Collaborate closely with Design, Content, Marketing, and Product teams to align organic initiatives with larger campaigns and launches.
    • Support product launches, campaigns, and announcements through strategic organic amplification.

Key Requirements

  • 1-3 years of experience managing brand or creator social media accounts with demonstrated success in driving organic growth.
  • Strong understanding of social media platforms and their algorithms, particularly Instagram and YouTube.
  • Working knowledge of SEO , Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) , and YouTube search optimization.
  • Understanding of Online Reputation Management (ORM) principles and how organic content influences brand perception.
  • Experience building or contributing to recurring content formats, creator series, or branded content IPs is highly preferred.
  • Excellent copywriting skills with a strong understanding of platform-specific tone and voice.
  • Strong awareness of internet culture, trends, and emerging content formats.
  • Experience using social media analytics tools such as Meta Business Suite and YouTube Studio.
  • Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and other AI-powered content and research tools.
  • Experience with social media management platforms like Hootsuite, Buffer, Sprout Social, or similar tools is a plus.
  • Prior experience working in a startup or high-growth environment is preferred.

What Were Looking For

  • A creative thinker with a strong understanding of internet culture and digital storytelling.
  • Someone who thinks beyond individual posts and builds scalable content systems and recurring formats.
  • A highly proactive individual with strong ownership and execution skills.
  • Detail-oriented with excellent organizational and project management abilities.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Curious, analytical, and excited to experiment with new ideas to drive organic growth.

  • Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns across multiple platforms while monitoring performance and recommending improvements for better results.

  • Leverage AI powered tools to efficiently generate high quality marketing content and continuously explore emerging AI tools and workflows to enhance productivity and creativity.

  • Completion of a Digital Marketing internship or relevant experience with a strong portfolio.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Basic understanding of SEO, social media marketing, and content marketing.
  • Experience creating social media content.
  • Basic graphic design skills using Canva or similar tools.

About the Role
We are looking for two highly motivated and hands-on Robotics AI Interns to join our research and development team. In this role, you will work at the cutting edge of physical AI, developing advanced software pipelines that enable intelligent systems to perceive their environments with high fidelity and execute complex, autonomous tasks.
This internship is designed for individuals who want to bridge the gap between state-of-the-art computer vision algorithms, modern deep learning architectures, and physical (or simulated) robotic platforms.
Core Responsibilities
You will collaborate with our engineering team to develop, test, and deploy software across our perception and autonomy stacks:
  • Advanced Perception Spatial Computing : Design and implement robust algorithms for environment reconstruction, scene understanding, and sensor processing. You will manipulate real-time data from depth sensors (RGB-D, LiDAR) to create spatial awareness for our platforms.
  • Embodied AI Intelligent Control : Develop, train, and deploy advanced learning-based policies for robotic systems. You will focus on multi-modal intelligence, enabling agents to translate complex sensory inputs into precise autonomous actions.
  • Simulation Physical Deployment : Build, configure, and utilize simulation environments (e.g., Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, PyBullet) to train and validate perception and control pipelines before deploying code onto hardware.
  • Systems Integration: Benchmark, optimize, and integrate deep learning models with classic robotics frameworks to ensure real-time, low-latency performance.
Technical Requirements
  • Education: Pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Computer Vision 3D Processing: Strong hands-on experience with OpenCV for image processing and PCL (Point Cloud Library) or Open3D for point cloud filtering, segmentation, and registration. Solid grasp of 3D geometry and coordinate transformations.
  • Deep Learning AI: Deep understanding of Neural Networks, with specific technical expertise in Transformer architectures, multi-modal models (Vision-Language), and attention mechanisms.
  • Software Engineering: High proficiency in Python and/or C++, with strong clean-coding practices, Git version control, and comfort working within Linux/Ubuntu environments.
  • Robotics Frameworks: Experience or familiarity with ROS/ROS2, imitation learning, behavioral cloning, or reinforcement learning applied to autonomous systems.
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience working directly with physical robotic hardware or deployment pipelines.
  • Experience with generative AI, diffusion models, or open-source foundation models.
  • Active contributions to open-source robotics, computer vision, or AI projects on GitHub.

Apprentice
About the Team
Global Central Operations is a key function supporting Corporate Solutions operations across APAC. The Credit Control team plays an important role in maintaining the financial health of the portfolio by supporting timely cash allocation, follow-up of outstanding balances, reconciliation activities, query management, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
Role Overview
The Apprentice will support the Credit Control team with routine operational, reconciliation, tracking, and reporting activities. This role is suitable for a fresh graduate who is eager to build foundational knowledge in finance operations, insurance/reinsurance accounting, cash management, and stakeholder communication within a structured corporate environment.
Key Responsibilities
  • Support tracking of cash application, premium allocation, and reconciliation activities.
  • Assist in monitoring unpaired cash, unsettled balances, and outstanding premium items.
  • Support follow-up activities with brokers, clients, internal teams, and outsourcing partners under guidance from the team.
  • Maintain and update operational trackers such as query trackers, broker follow-up trackers, reconciliation trackers, and audit support logs.
  • Assist in preparing data for governance reviews, dashboards, KPI monitoring, and monthly reporting.
  • Support data validation, document collection, evidence preparation, and audit related activities.
  • Help with query screening, follow-ups, and coordination to ensure timely closure of open items.
  • Learn and support basic Credit Control processes including incoming payments, outgoing payments, manual pairing, and settlement follow-ups.
  • Assist in maintaining process documentation, SOP updates, and control evidence where required.
  • Participate in team meetings, process training, and continuous improvement initiatives.
What You Will Learn
  • Foundational understanding of Credit Control and cash management processes.
  • Exposure to insurance and reinsurance finance operations in a global environment.
  • Practical experience in reconciliation, reporting, data validation, and operational controls.
  • Understanding of stakeholder communication, follow-up discipline, and service delivery standards.
  • Experience working with internal teams, brokers, clients, and outsourcing partners.
  • Awareness of audit readiness, process documentation, and control requirements.
Required Skills and Qualifications
  • B.Com, BBA, or equivalent undergraduate degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.
  • Basic understanding of accounting concepts and financial reporting.
  • Working knowledge of MS Excel; exposure to PowerPoint and Word will be an added advantage.
  • Excellent business communication and cross-cultural skills, both verbal and written. Ability to adapt and learn in a multifaceted environment by demonstrating a strong team player skill sets.
  • Strong attention to detail and willingness to work with data, trackers, and reports.
  • Ability to follow instructions, ask questions, and learn structured processes.
  • Good ownership mindset, learning agility, and ability to manage assigned tasks within timelines.
  • Interest in finance operations, insurance/reinsurance, credit control, or business operations.
Opportunity Summary
This apprenticeship provides a strong learning platform for fresh graduates to understand finance operations and Credit Control processes in a global corporate environment. The role is designed to build practical exposure, process discipline, stakeholder communication skills, and a foundation for future career growth in finance and operations.
Experience Level
Entry Level

Fuel customer growth through meaningful, intelligent, and safe user-to-user (and now, user-to-agent) engagement.

CometChat Overview
CometChat is a full-stack conversational platform built to unify every layer of interaction - bringing together real-time conversations (chat, messaging, voice, and video), AI Agents, moderation, notifications, and analytics in one modular, developer-first solution.
Our company has seen rapid growth, thanks to several market validations - including our participation in the Techstars Boulder Accelerator in 2019, followed by investments from experienced investors such as iSeed Ventures, Range Ventures, Silicon Badia, and Matchstick Ventures. CometChat raised a Series A round led by Signal Peak/Run Ventures. In the last 12 months alone, more than 2 billion messages have been sent through our platform.
We were also recognized on Forbes 2026 Americas Top 500 Startup Employers List - a reflection of the team and culture weve been deliberate about building.
We believe the interface of the future is conversation - not clicks. Every app will soon have an AI layer thats as native as text messaging today. Thats why were building the infrastructure for the worlds AI-powered conversations - from human-to-human, to human-to-agent, to multi-party collaboration with AI in the mix.
From AI onboarding assistants that get users productive in minutes, to copilots that perform complex workflows in-app, to intelligent moderators that protect and guide communities in real time - our AI Agent platform makes it all possible.
With CometChats ready-to-use UI kits, powerful SDKs, and our Full Stack AI Agent Platform, product teams across startups and enterprises can launch safe, scalable, and smart in-app interactions faster than ever.
Why Join Us Now
Were at the tipping point where AI becomes a native part of every conversation. At CometChat, youll help shape a future where users can talk to their apps as naturally as to a friend - where agents think, reason, act, and collaborate with humans in real time.
You wont just be joining a product team - youll be building the standard for AI interaction layers: agent-aware UI, intelligent guardrails, rich actions libraries, and multi-party collaboration between people and AI.
If you want to help define how the next billion users will communicate - and push the boundaries of whats possible in real-time, AI-powered engagement - wed love to work with you.
What we mean by AI-native
AI-native here means you build with agents by default. We expect 100% of the code to be generated via agentic tools (Cursor, Claude Code, and similar), while you own everything that actually matters: problem framing, architecture, tradeoffs, review quality, tests, performance, and security. This is not "vibe coding." The code is generated. The thinking is yours. You should be great at steering agents, validating output, catching subtle issues early, and debugging code you did not manually write.
Why AI-native
Software development is changing permanently, and we are leaning all the way in. You will work in a team that ships fast with agents, where your leverage comes from judgment and systems thinking rather than typing speed. You will get access to whatever AI tools you need (Cursor, Claude Code, or anything else that makes you effective), and the freedom to use them aggressively. If you want to operate at the edge of how modern engineering gets done and level up your output, this role is built for that.
Join us to build where AI meets human connection.

Were hiring a Product Manager to own our core product surface the chat, calls, moderation, and AI Agent (Bring Your Own Agent) capabilities that most CometChat customers use today.

This is a growth-stage operator role, not a 0-to-1 role. The product is mature, the customers are real, and the revenue is meaningful. Your job is to grow it through better, faster, and bigger versions of what works, plus new capabilities that expand the product.

The intern will assist in evaluating aerodynamic performance and internal flow behavior through CFD simulations, while learning industry-standard turbomachinery analysis practices.

  • Post-process simulation results and create visualizations, plots, and technical summaries.

  • Follow established CFD best practices, validation procedures, and quality standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to support development activities and meet project timelines.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor s or Master s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field.
  • Basic understanding of fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, and turbomachinery concepts.
  • Familiarity with CFD tools such as ANSYS Fluent, CFX, or similar simulation software is preferred.
  • Exposure to CAD software such as CATIA, SpaceClaim, SolidWorks, or OnShape is an advantage.
  • Knowledge of meshing techniques and rotating machinery simulations is a plus.
  • Basic programming or scripting knowledge (Python or MATLAB) is desirable.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, especially PowerPoint and Excel.
  • Self-motivated, eager to learn, and able to work effectively in a team environment.

What You Will Gain

  • Practical experience in turbomachinery CFD simulations and analysis.
  • Exposure to industry-standard engineering tools and workflows.
  • Opportunity to work on advanced turbocharger and ZEV technologies.
  • Mentorship from experienced CFD and aerodynamic engineers.
  • Experience in technical reporting, engineering communication, and collaborative product development.

We are looking for an Elixir Developer to join our team building backend services for scalable, production-grade applications. This is not a role where you simply execute PRDs. Instead, you will be a business-minded engineer who deeply understands the product use cases, business objectives, and strategic implications of technical decisions.

You will design and extend backend services using the Ash Framework, working across resources, actions, and data layers to ship features fast without sacrificing correctness. Our backend is Elixir/Phoenix with Ash as the core application framework, backed by PostgreSQL, deployed on Fly.io. You will spend most of your time inside Ashs resource-oriented patterns rather than hand-rolling boilerplate.

This is a framework-deep role with a business-first mindset.

Key Responsibilities

  • Business Product Collaboration: Work closely with product managers and business stakeholders to understand use cases, market context, and business objectives before diving into technical implementation
  • Ask critical questions about business impact, trade-offs, and long-term implications of technical decisions
  • Communicate technical constraints, risks, and opportunities in business-friendly language to non-technical stakeholders
  • Contribute to architectural and strategic decisions by providing context on how technical choices affect business outcomes
  • Technical Design Development: Design and build Ash resources, actions, calculations, and policies for core product features with a deep understanding of their business purpose
  • Write clean, testable Elixir code following OTP and Phoenix conventions
  • Build interactive, real-time UI where needed using Phoenix LiveView
  • Design and maintain PostgreSQL schemas, migrations, and query performance with business scalability in mind
  • Build and extend APIs (GraphQL/REST via AshGraphql/AshJsonApi or Phoenix controllers) that serve real production traffic
  • AI Advanced Features: Integrate LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini) and vector databases into product features (semantic search, embeddings, retrieval-based workflows)
  • Use AI coding assistants effectively to accelerate development without sacrificing code quality
  • Understand the business implications of AI-powered features and their impact on user experience and product strategy
  • Operations Ownership: Instrument features with product analytics (PostHog) to track usage and inform iteration
  • Maintain Docker-based dev containers for a consistent, reproducible local development setup
  • Deploy, monitor, and scale services on Fly.io
  • Own features end-to-end: from understanding requirements and business context to deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement
  • Participate in production debugging, monitoring, and performance tuning with an eye toward business impact
  • Team Process: Collaborate with frontend engineers, QA, product managers, and project leads in a cross-functional environment
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architecture decisions with a focus on business value
  • Champion clear thinking and ownership mindset within the engineering team

    • What Youll Work On

    • Resource-driven backend architecture using Ash (resources, actions, relationships, policies, calculations, aggregates)
    • Workflow logic, versioning, and multi-step business processes modeled declaratively in Ash
    • Real-time, interactive features built with Phoenix LiveView
    • Vector DB-backed features such as semantic search, embeddings storage, and retrieval-augmented workflows
    • Background jobs and async processing (Oban or similar)
    • Database design, query optimization, and migrations in PostgreSQL
    • Integration with third-party services and internal microservices
    • Local development standardized via Docker and dev containers
    • Deployment, release management, and scaling on Fly.io
    • Production debugging, monitoring, and performance tuning

    Tech Stack

    • Languages: Elixir
    • Frameworks: Phoenix, Phoenix LiveView, Ash Framework (AshPostgres, AshGraphql/AshJsonApi, Ash Authentication as applicable)
    • Databases: PostgreSQL, Vector DB (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, or similar)
    • AI/LLM: Claude, Gemini (API-level integration), Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot

jobDescription:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

The mission - Sprinto is building the next phase of its outbound sales engine and this isnt a traditional SDR role.

Youll own a Target Account List of US-based mid-market and enterprise companies and run the full outbound motion to get the right GRC buyers in front of our Account Executives. Your mission is simple: map the accounts, find the right people, start meaningful conversations, and consistently create pipeline that turns into revenue.

Youll partner closely with an Account Executive carrying a $400K $600K quota, working on enterprise deals averaging $30K $60K ACV. You wont just hand over leads youll stay close to the deals you create, gaining first-hand exposure to how complex enterprise sales are won.

If youre looking for a role that teaches you how to think like an enterprise seller and not just book meetings, this is where that journey begins.

Where Youll Leave Your Mark

  • Master enterprise account strategy - Before the first cold call, youll map buying committees, understand stakeholder priorities, and identify the right path into every account. Youll develop the strategic account-planning skills that form the foundation of every great enterprise seller.
  • Build pipeline that fuels revenue - Your outbound motion calls, emails, LinkedIn, webinars, and creative outreach will generate qualified conversations that move deals forward. Youll be measured on business impact, not just activity, and learn what it takes to consistently create revenue opportunities.
  • Own a pipeline from day one - Youll create and manage a disciplined outbound motion across a 30 60 day sales cycle, building the resilience, consistency, and commercial judgment needed to succeed in enterprise sales.
  • Build AI-powered outbound systems - We expect you to experiment with AI, automation, and smarter ways of working. The workflows, playbooks, and systems you build wont just make you more effective theyll become part of how Sprinto scales outbound, and a portfolio of work youll carry throughout your career.
  • Learn one seat away from closing - By partnering closely with experienced AEs, youll see how enterprise deals are navigated from first conversation to signed customer. For people who aspire to become Account Executives, this role is designed as a launchpad not a stop.

The Kind of Builder Were Looking For -

  • Youve spent the last 1 3 years sharpening your outbound craft and are now looking for a role that teaches you how enterprise sales is really won.
  • The phone is your first instinct, not your last resort. You enjoy real conversations and know that trust is built one call at a time.
  • You research before you reach out. Understanding the business, the buyer, and the context matters more to you than simply increasing activity.
  • Youve already experimented with AI, automation, prospecting tools, or outbound workflows because youre always looking for smarter ways to work not just harder ones.
  • Youre naturally curious in conversations. You ask thoughtful questions, listen carefully, and enjoy uncovering what really matters to buyers.
  • You bring consistency to your work. Whether its prospecting, follow-ups, or pipeline hygiene, you know great outbound is built through discipline, not bursts of effort.
  • Youre excited by enterprise sales and understand that earning the attention of senior buyers takes patience, preparation, and persistence not just great messaging.
  • You enjoy working closely with Account Executives and want to understand what happens after the meeting is booked because your ambition is bigger than simply generating pipeline.

You will enjoy Sprinto if -

  • Stepping in before someone has to step up.
  • Wearing multiple hats without counting them.
  • Leaving egos at the door and winning as one team.
  • Taking the harder right over the easier wrong.
  • Shipping, learning, repeating.
  • Staying curious and never staying in your lane.

Inclusion Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create.

Digital Marketing Specialist Social Media & Performance Marketing

Location: Ranchi, Jharkhand
Job Type: Full-Time
Work Mode: On-site

We are looking for a Digital Marketing Specialist who understands that digital marketing is not just about posting content, boosting posts, or increasing followers.

We need someone who understands why people stop, watch, engage, enquire and eventually become customers.

Your job will be to combine Content + Consumer Psychology + Data + Paid Advertising to grow our social media presence and generate quality leads.

What You'll Be Responsible For

  • Build and execute our Instagram, Facebook and YouTube growth strategy
  • Plan content calendars with the creative team
  • Identify content topics based on audience interests, search behaviour and market trends
  • Work closely with videographers, editors and content creators
  • Analyse which Reels/videos are performing and why
  • Improve hooks, thumbnails, captions, CTAs and content positioning
  • Run and optimize Meta Ads & Google Ads
  • Create lead-generation and remarketing campaigns
  • Track leads from Ad Landing Page/WhatsApp Enquiry Conversion
  • Conduct A/B tests on creatives, audiences, hooks and offers
  • Build retargeting audiences
  • Monitor campaign performance and optimize budgets
  • Prepare simple weekly/monthly performance reports

The Skills We're Looking For

1. Social Media Strategy

You should understand:

  • Instagram Reels
  • Facebook
  • YouTube & YouTube Shorts
  • Organic content growth
  • Content distribution
  • Audience building
  • Engagement & retention
  • Social-media trends
  • Competitor research

You shouldn't simply tell us:

“This Reel got 50,000 views.”

You should be able to explain:

“Why did it get 50,000 views, where did viewers drop, what made people share it, and how can we repeat that success?”

2. Performance Marketing

Hands-on experience with:

  • Meta Ads Manager
  • Facebook & Instagram Ads
  • Google Ads
  • Lead-generation campaigns
  • Conversion campaigns
  • Remarketing
  • Lookalike/custom audiences
  • Campaign budgeting
  • Creative testing
  • A/B testing
  • Cost-per-lead optimization

You should understand metrics such as:

CPL • CTR • CPC • CPM • Conversion Rate • ROAS • CAC

But more importantly, you should understand what action to take when those numbers aren't performing.

3. Analytics

Working knowledge of:

  • Meta Business Suite
  • Meta Ads Manager
  • Google Analytics / GA4
  • Google Search Console
  • YouTube Analytics
  • Google Trends
  • Pixel & conversion tracking
  • UTM tracking

We want someone who can turn data into decisions, not simply download reports.

4. Consumer Psychology

This is extremely important for us.

You should be curious about:

Why does someone click?

Why does someone watch one Reel for 3 seconds and another for 40 seconds?

Why does someone save a video but not enquire?

Why does one advertisement generate cheap but poor-quality leads while another generates fewer but serious customers?

Understanding attention, curiosity, trust, objections, desire and buying behaviour will be a major advantage.

Content Marketing

You don't necessarily have to shoot or edit every video.

But you should be able to guide the creative team on:

Topic Hook Content Angle Thumbnail CTA Distribution Retargeting

You should be comfortable telling the team:

“Video achha hai, but opening ke first 3 seconds weak hain. Let's test another hook.”

That's the mindset we're looking for.

Qualification

Degree is preferred. Skills are mandatory.

Bachelor's degree / Diploma in:

  • Digital Marketing
  • Marketing
  • Mass Communication
  • Business/Management
  • Media
  • Advertising

is an advantage, but not compulsory.

Candidates with strong practical knowledge and proven results are encouraged to apply even without a specialized degree.

Experience

1–3 years preferred.

Freshers can also apply if they have exceptional practical knowledge and can demonstrate their work.

Agency experience, personal projects, freelancing or managing your own successful social-media pages will also be considered.

Who We're Looking For

Someone who is:

Analytical + Creative + Curious + Result-Oriented

Someone who doesn't wait for instructions for everything.

If a campaign isn't working, you should naturally want to know:

“Why?”

If a Reel suddenly performs 10X better than usual:

“Why?”

If competitors are growing faster:

“What are they doing differently?”

That curiosity matters to us.

What We DON'T Want

Someone whose entire strategy is:

“Sir, 500 ka boost kar dete hain.”

We are looking for someone who understands the difference between boosting a post and building an actual marketing system.

How to Apply

Please send:

  1. CV
  2. Previous social-media pages/accounts managed
  3. Examples of Meta/Google campaigns you've handled
  4. Any measurable results you've achieved
  5. Tools you're comfortable using
  6. Current location
  7. Current/Last salary
  8. Expected salary

Work Location: Ranchi, Jharkhand

jobDescription:
The Role

This is a full-cycle sales role. You will own everything from finding the right prospect to handing over a signed client - there is no SDR passing you leads, no pre-sales team doing the first call, and no account manager taking over after closure. You do it all, with demo support available when you need it.

You will be selling across three distinct product lines to three different buyer personas - HR leaders, finance and audit heads, and operations or project managers. The ability to switch context, speak the language of different decision-makers, and manage multiple pipelines simultaneously is central to this role.

What You Will Do

1. Database Generation & Prospecting

  • Build and maintain a structured prospect database across all three product lines and their respective buyer personas
  • Source contacts using LinkedIn, industry directories, CODISSIA / Chamber of Commerce member lists, trade publications, and local business networks
  • Segment database by product fit, company size, industry, and geography (CBE, Tirupur, Erode, and pan-Tamil Nadu as the business grows)
  • Maintain clean, updated records in CRM - every contact, every interaction, every follow-up logged

2. Cold Outreach & Lead Generation

  • Execute outbound outreach via phone calls, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, and email - targeting the right person with the right product message
  • Craft personalised outreach for each product and each buyer persona - the pitch to an HR Manager is fundamentally different from the pitch to a CFO
  • Handle gatekeepers, navigate to decision-makers, and earn the right to a conversation without being pushy
  • Consistently generate 40-60 qualified conversations per month across all product lines

3. Demo Scheduling & Coordination

  • Qualify prospects thoroughly before scheduling a demo - understand their pain, confirm decision-making authority, and set expectations
  • Coordinate with the internal demo support team to schedule and prepare tailored product demonstrations
  • Attend every demo as the relationship owner - your role during the demo is to read the room, handle objections in real time, and guide the conversation toward next steps
  • Brief the demo support team on the prospect's specific context and priorities before each session

4. Follow-Up,

  • Own the post-demo follow-up process - proposals, pricing discussions, handling objections, and pushing toward a decision
  • Navigate multi-stakeholder decisions where HR, Finance, and Operations may all have a say
  • Manage sales cycles ranging from 2 weeks (SMB, HR product) to 3 months (enterprise, audit tool) simultaneously
  • Close deals, coordinate onboarding handover to the delivery team, and maintain the relationship through the initial implementation period

5. Pipeline Management & Reporting

  • Maintain a live, accurate pipeline in CRM across all three products at all times
  • Report weekly to the founder on: leads generated, demos scheduled, proposals sent, deals closed, and blockers
  • Identify patterns - which products are gaining traction, which industries are responding, which buyer personas are hardest to reach - and share insights with the team
  • Set and track personal monthly targets for outreach volume, demo count, and revenue closure.

Job Description
Title: International AI Research Fellowship
Industry: IT Services
Duration: 20 hours per month | Paid | 12 weeks
Net Solutions is looking for curious, analytical university students to join a small international research program exploring how AI is changing technology, commerce, marketing, and business. This is not a conventional internship. Fellows will work on real research questions that matter to Net Solutions and its clients. You will be given a defined problem to investigate, access to our team and relevant materials, and considerable freedom in how you approach it. We expect you to use AI extensively. We also expect you to question it.


Responsibilities
  • Projects will vary, but examples could include:
  • How companies in your market are adopting AI
  • How AI is changing ecommerce and digital buying
  • How businesses are preparing their content and product data for AI-driven discovery
  • How leading companies are positioning new AI products and services
  • How buyers are finding and evaluating technology partners
  • Emerging AI tools, platforms, and business models
  • Competitor and market landscapes
  • Research into specific industries, companies, or technologies
  • How AI-generated answers differ across markets
  • New opportunities created by agentic AI and AI-driven commerce
  • These are examples rather than a fixed curriculum. Each Fellow will receive a defined research brief.


Key Requirements
  • Depending on your project, you may:
  • Find and evaluate primary and secondary sources
  • Interview or speak with relevant people where appropriate
  • Analyze companies, competitors, and market developments
  • Use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other AI tools as research partners
  • Verify AI-generated claims rather than accepting them at face value
  • Identify patterns and insights in the information you collect
  • Produce concise written research
  • Present your findings and recommendations to the Net Solutions team


Nice to have
  • Currently studying at a university
  • Intellectually curious
  • A strong researcher
  • Comfortable writing in English
  • Able to distinguish evidence from assertion
  • Comfortable using modern AI tools
  • Willing to challenge AI output
  • Interested in technology, business, AI, or digital commerce
  • Able to work independently
  • Good at turning a large amount of information into a clear point of view
  • Students studying business, economics, computer science, engineering, design, marketing, journalism, social sciences, and other disciplines are welcome.
  • TIME COMMITMENT
  • The Fellowship runs for 12 weeks.
  • Expected commitment is approximately 20 hours per month, or roughly 45 hours per week.
  • There are no daily working hours. The program is designed to fit alongside university.
  • Most work will be asynchronous, with periodic online meetings with the Net Solutions team.
  • LOCATION
  • The Fellowship is remote and open to university students based in:
  • United States
  • Canada
  • United Kingdom
  • Australia
  • South Africa
  • Applicants should normally be studying and living in the market for which they apply.
  • COMPENSATION
  • This is a paid program. The expected monthly fellowship award is:
  • United States: US$500 per month
  • Canada: C$600 per month
  • United Kingdom: 350 per month
  • Australia: A$600 per month
  • South Africa: R5,000 per month
  • The award reflects the expected 20-hour monthly commitment and participation in the 12-week Fellowship.
  • HOW WE THINK ABOUT AI
  • We are not looking for people who simply know how to prompt ChatGPT.
  • We are looking for people who know when not to believe it.
  • Use AI to explore, challenge, organize, and accelerate your thinking. But the evidence, judgment, and conclusions in your work remain yours.


Collaboration
  • SELECTION PROCESS
  • 1. Application
  • Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile and tell us briefly about something you have researched, built, written, or investigated because you were genuinely curious about it.
  • 2. Short research challenge
  • Shortlisted applicants will receive a small research problem. You may use any tools, including AI.
  • We will assess the quality of your thinking, sources, and conclusions rather than how polished the document looks.
  • 3. Conversation
  • Finalists will have a short conversation with the Net Solutions team about their research, how they approached it, and what they learned.
  • The strongest Fellows may be invited to work with Net Solutions on future research or other opportunities.

Title: AI Marketing Research Associate

Industry: IT Services

Net Solutions is looking for an unusually sharp university student or recent graduate in the UK to work with our marketing team on research, content, AI-assisted workflows, and marketing operations. This is not a conventional marketing internship. We are looking for someone who can take an unfamiliar business question, research it properly, use AI intelligently, challenge what the AI produces, and turn the work into something useful. You do not need years of marketing experience. You do need to be a strong thinker, researcher, and communicator.


Responsibilities
  • Researching industries, companies, competitors, and market trends
  • Reviewing AI-generated articles and marketing copy for logic, accuracy, and weak arguments
  • Finding and verifying credible primary sources for claims and statistics
  • Researching prospects and target accounts for campaigns and events
  • Comparing competitor positioning, services, and go-to-market approaches
  • Supporting SEO and AI-search research
  • Helping turn research into useful content, campaign, and sales material
  • Testing ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other AI tools against real marketing tasks
  • Developing repeatable AI-assisted processes that make our marketing team faster
  • Bringing a UK-market perspective to messaging, research, and campaigns
  • You will work on live Net Solutions initiatives rather than simulated internship projects.


Nice to have
  • Excellent written English
  • Strong research and analytical ability
  • An instinct for questioning information rather than simply accepting it
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • The ability to understand unfamiliar subjects quickly
  • Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini
  • The ability to distinguish credible evidence from something that merely looks credible
  • Good judgment about what makes writing clear, useful, and believable
  • Curiosity about technology, AI, business, and marketing
  • The ability to work independently once the objective is clear
  • A marketing or technical degree is not required.
  • HOW WE THINK ABOUT AI
  • We expect you to use AI extensively.
  • We also expect you to recognize when it is wrong, generic, poorly reasoned, or unsupported.
  • If your approach is simply to ask ChatGPT to produce an answer and submit it, this role will not be a good fit.
  • The ability to challenge AI output matters more to us than knowing clever prompts.

  • This is a 12-week, part-time paid position, requiring approximately 1520 hours per week.

  • Hours can be arranged around university commitments.
  • COMPENSATION
  • 1620 per hour, depending on demonstrated ability and experience.


Collaboration
  • SELECTION PROCESS
  • 1. Application
  • Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile and, if possible, something that demonstrates how you think, research, or write.
  • 2. Paid practical assignment
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a short exercise involving research, AI-generated content, fact checking, and judgment.
  • You may use any AI tools you want.
  • We are interested in both what you produce and how you got there.
  • 3. Conversation
  • A short discussion about your assignment, how you approached it, what you disagreed with, and what you would do differently.
  • Exceptional performers may be considered for future opportunities with Net Solutions.

descriptionFromApi:
The Opportunity

Join us as an AI Demo Engineer, a truly ground-floor role where you ll be instrumental in shaping the future of Scout, our brand-new AI product. You ll tackle the exciting challenge of building, not just maintaining, dynamic AI-powered demonstrations that empower our Sales Engineers and directly drive deal closures. This is your chance to build a critical function from scratch, defining processes and making a tangible impact on our market approach, bringing real variety and ownership to every project.

What Youll Do

As our first AI Demo Engineer in Bangalore, you will occupy a unique, pivotal position, bridging the gap between traditional Demo Engineering and AI engineering. Your primary focus will be on constructing sophisticated agentic Scout workflows, moving beyond static demo data to craft intelligent, multi-step solutions. You will own the creation of a comprehensive library of reusable standard demo agents, complete with robust data and documentation, serving as the essential foundation for all sales demonstrations. Furthermore, you will design and implement prospect-specific agents tailored to individual deal requirements, directly contributing to successful sales outcomes. A crucial part of your role involves maintaining the main demo template, ensuring it remains current, functional after platform updates, and populated with fresh data and golden records. Beyond building, you will become a diagnostic expert, analyzing prospect usage within Proof-of-Concept (POC) instances, identifying why a solution might not be landing, and expertly tuning agents, data, and configurations to optimize outcomes and secure conversions. You wont inherit a fixed process; instead, youll help define the operating model for this critical new team function.

The Skills Youll Have

Agentic AI / Scout Configuration

  • Youll build or configure at least one agentic AI workflow, demonstrating proficiency with agents that plan, call tools, and complete multi-step tasks.

  • Youll possess hands-on prompt engineering experience, having written and iterated prompts/instructions for LLM-based tools.

  • Youll have a basic understanding of MCP (Multi-Cloud Platform) or comparable tool-calling/connector patterns.

  • Youll have designed multi-system agentic workflows end-to-end, showcasing your ability to move beyond single-agent/single-tool solutions.

  • Youll have built or worked directly with MCP connectors, leveraging your deep technical expertise.

Business Translation & Demo Enablement

  • Youll translate complex business requirements into working demos, prototypes, or configurations without extensive guidance.

  • Youll produce clear documentation or handoff guides that empower others to successfully run a build you created.

  • Youll quickly understand a prospects business process, translating it into value-led Scout workflows and compelling demo scripts.

  • Youll scope realistic deliverables and deadlines in collaboration with Sales Engineers, proactively closing gaps in incomplete requirements.

  • Youll hold one or more Salesforce certifications, and/or possess direct Sitetracker platform experience, enhancing your industry relevance.

POC Analysis & Tuning

  • Youll analyze the usage of a live tool or instance and implement changes that measurably improved its performance.

  • Youll be comfortable reading how a system is actually being used, rather than relying solely on its intended design.

  • Youll diagnose why a POC instance is or isnt landing, treating challenges as diagnostic problems to solve.

  • Youll tune agents, data, and configurations to improve POC outcomes, directly affecting conversion rates.

  • Contribute your first prospect-specific agent builds to active sales opportunities, gaining hands-on experience in high-stakes scenarios.

If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you'll find your place here. DigitalOcean is building the substrate for an AI-native company, and the AI Engineering team is doing that work. It spans three connected pillars: internal AI copilots and agents for teams across Finance, People, Sales, Marketing, Support, and IT; the internal AI platform that powers them-model access and routing, agent runtimes, evaluation harnesses, and the developer tooling around them; and re-architecting business processes across our enterprise systems footprint to be AI-native. Our engineers in the US and India work together across time zones, each owning delivery end to end for their business domains while contributing to the shared platform.

You will join the team in India, working alongside senior engineers who will help you grow quickly, with technical direction from our architect. You will take on well-scoped work with real users on the other end of it, and steadily take on more ownership.

They conduct technical audits to identify issues with crawlability, indexability, and speed, helping our sites stay competitive and ready for both traditional bots and new AI crawlers.

Working within the Senior Manager s strategy, the Specialist performs data-driven keyword research and content reviews to find search trends and fill knowledge gaps. They apply E-E-A-T principles, Natural Language Processing and Entity Optimization to ensure our brand earns top rankings and AI citations. They also build and manage Schema markup to label our data, making it easy for engines like Bing and ChatGPT to trust our content.

Partnering with Product, Design, and MarTech, they deploy scalable improvements that keep our sites healthy and help the brand grow. Success means getting the right people to our sites, so they become customers and bring in revenue. We track progress by winning more market share in both regular and AI search, driving organic growth, and making sure our sites work perfectly for both people and bots.

Technical Site Health & Engineering

descriptionFromApi:
Job Summary

Communications and External Relations (CER) is to help deliver financial and political support for the World Bank Group, strengthen the Bank Group s role as a global thought leader in development by enhancing and safeguarding its reputation, and supporting operational teams to achieve country outcomes. CER manages corporate communications and global engagement with key stakeholders, including media, civil society, foundations, private sector, donor countries, and international organizations, as well as employee engagement. CER also manages strategic communications for the World Bank Group s Regions and technical units and leads the management of reputation risk.

Regional Stakeholder Engagement in CER (CERRS) manages strategic communications across the seven regions of the World Bank Group driving engagement across regions and country offices to align local efforts with our global strategy.

The work aims to build support and understanding for World Bank Group (WBG) priorities across a range of stakeholders; enhance and protect the reputation of the WBG as a leading development organization; support operational effectiveness and social accountability by sharing development progress, knowledge, and results.

Recognizing that economic and social contexts evolve rapidly, and that communications technologies have revolutionized the ways that information travels, we are building a team of dynamic and innovative professionals prepared to use innovative engagement strategies, traditional and digital tools, including social media and artificial intelligence to shape the debate on development priorities and tradeoffs.

is among the world s fastest-growing, most dynamic regions. The World Bank partners with countries across EAP to promote economic growth and job creation, strengthen human capital, and advance sustainable energy, water, and agriculture for a resilient and prosperous future for all. Over the past two decades, EAP has sustained strong growth, lifting hundreds of millions of people out of poverty and transforming economies and lives. Many countries have reached upper-middle-income status and are aiming for high-income status. Poverty rates continue to fall, with 24 million people in the region projected to escape poverty between 2024 and 2025 (based on the upper-middle-income poverty line).

Despite this progress, major challenges remain. About 320 million people will reach working age over the next decade, while only around 110 million new jobs are projected-making job creation an urgent priority. Widening inequality within and across countries underscores the need to expand access to education, healthcare, and social safety nets, particularly for the urban poor and rural communities. Rapid urbanization increases demand for transport connectivity, water and sanitation, and pollution management. Meeting rising electricity needs at affordable cost-without sharply increasing greenhouse gas emissions-requires accelerating the energy transition. Adaptation and resilience to extreme weather and natural disasters are critical in a region that includes 13 of the world s 30 most climate-vulnerable countries. Since 2000, EAP has experienced 70 percent of the world s natural disasters, affecting more than 1.6 billion people.

East Asia and Pacific Regional Stakeholder Engagement Team (CEREA)

The East Asia and Pacific (EAP) Regional Stakeholder Engagement team (CEREA) manages strategic communications and external relations in support of the WBG strategic priorities in EAP. It includes communications and external relations professionals both in Washington, D.C. and WBG EAP Country Offices.

CEREA s goal is to connect and engage with diverse stakeholders across EAP to communicate about the WBG mission to create a world free of poverty on a livable planet, promote an informed, evidence-based debate about development in the region, and enhance the WBG s reputation as an effective development partner for the countries of East Asia and Pacific. CEREA s key audiences include government officials, think tanks and researchers, business leaders and associations, investors, development partners, civil society organizations, and journalists.

Senior Communications and External Affairs Officer

The Senior External Affairs Officer is a senior member of the EAP (CEREA) Regional Stakeholder Engagement team and serves as a strategic advisor to regional management on stakeholder engagement, communications, advocacy, and reputational risk management.

The position plays a key role in advancing the World Bank Groups regional stakeholder engagement agenda and driving delivery across CERs four business lines: Stakeholder Engagement, Strategic Business Marketing, Advocacy & Campaigns, and Risk & Issue Management. The role requires strong strategic judgment, political awareness, and the ability to anticipate risks, influence stakeholders, shape narratives, and mobilize support for development priorities.

Working closely with regional and country management, operational teams, and colleagues across IBRD, IDA, IFC, and MIGA, the Senior Communications and External Affairs Officer helps advance a coordinated One World Bank Group approach to external affairs. The position combines strategic advisory responsibilities with hands-on delivery and is expected to lead complex assignments, support priority initiatives, and contribute directly to execution across the regional portfolio.

The Senior Communications & External Relations Officer position is based in Washington, D.C. and reports to CER Manager, EAP.

Key Responsibilities

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Lead stakeholder engagement strategies that advance World Bank Group priorities, support country outcomes, and strengthen the institutions influence across the region.
  • Build and maintain relationships with key stakehholders, including government officials, development partners, private sector leaders, civil society organizations, media, academia, and other influential actors.
  • Lead stakeholder intelligence efforts, including stakeholder mapping, analysis, and monitoring of actors, coalitions, and trends that may affect World Bank Group priorities, reform efforts, or reputation.
  • Advise management and operational teams on stakeholder dynamics, political economy considerations, coalition-building opportunities, and engagement approaches.
  • Ensure stakeholder insights and external perspectives are incorporated into communications strategies, advocacy efforts, risk management, and operational decision-making.

Strategic Business Marketing

  • Position the World Bank Group as a trusted development partner by articulating the value of integrated public-private solutions and the One World Bank Group approach.
  • Develop strategic narratives, engagement approaches, and communications products that support regional priorities, operational objectives, and client engagement.
  • Identify and elevate flagship operations, reform milestones, knowledge products, and success stories that demonstrate impact and generate demand for World Bank Group engagement.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen visibility and understanding of the World Bank Groups work among governments, investors, private sector partners, foundations, and development stakeholders.

Advocacy & Campaigns

  • Lead advocacy and communications campaigns that support development priorities, reform efforts, and institutional objectives.
  • Develop compelling messaging and narratives that translate complex development issues into clear, accessible, and persuasive communications.
  • Coordinate regional contributions to corporate and global campaigns, adapting messages and approaches to regional and country contexts.
  • Oversee the development of speeches, op-eds, press releases, talking points, digital content, and other communications products for senior management and key stakeholders.
  • Help ensure consistent, targeted, and effective messaging across communications, stakeholder engagement, digital, and media channels.

Risk & Issue Management

  • Serve as a senior advisor on reputational risk and issue management, helping management anticipate, assess, and respond to developments that could affect World Bank Group operations, stakeholder relationships, or reputation.

Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we dont wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams arent built by sitting together, theyre built by pulling in the same direction.

descriptionFromApi:
Job Summary

Were looking for a Principal AI Automation Test Engineer to define and drive the automation and AI-testing strategy across multiple products and teams. Youll own the technical direction of our quality engineering practice - architecting frameworks, setting standards, mentoring engineers, and pioneering the adoption of AI/ML-driven testing at scale. This is a hands-on leadership role: you still write and review code, but your impact is measured in the reliability, velocity, and maturity of automation across the org.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and own end-to-end automation frameworks in JavaScript/TypeScript (Playwright, Cypress, WebdriverIO, Cucumber/BDD) and Java (Selenium WebDriver, TestNG/JUnit), and set the patterns other teams build on.
  • Define the org-wide automation strategy - test pyramid, coverage targets, tooling standards, and the build-vs-buy decisions for testing platforms.
  • Lead API automation (REST/GraphQL) architecture across JS and Java tooling (Supertest/Postman, RestAssured), including contract testing and service virtualization.
  • Champion AI/ML-powered testing - self-healing locators, visual regression, and intelligent/risk-based test selection - running evaluations and driving adoption decisions across teams.
  • Integrate LLMs and AI coding assistants (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, custom GPT/agent workflows) into the engineering lifecycle, and establish where they add value vs. where they introduce risk - codified as team guidance.
  • Design test strategies for AI/LLM-powered product features - handling non-determinism, building eval-style and guardrail assertions, and defining quality bars for generative features.
  • Own CI/CD test pipeline architecture (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Bitbucket Pipelines, Azure DevOps) and containerized/parallel execution (Docker, and orchestration at scale).
  • Establish flaky-test governance - root-cause practices, quarantine policies, and reliability metrics that keep suites trustworthy across the org.
  • Mentor and level up automation engineers; run design reviews, set code-quality standards (POM, centralized locators, data-driven design), and grow the teams AI-testing capability.
  • Partner with engineering leadership and product to shift quality left and embed testing into the SDLC as a first-class concern.

title: Full-Stack Developer (Backend-Focused) - Python Stack
jobDescription:
Experience with relational database design and migrations. .

Experience consuming third-party APIs (payment processors,webhooks,integrations). . Redis or caching layer optimisation. . GitHub Actions or similar CI / CD pipeline experience. .

Prior experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI,Anthropic,etc.)
descriptionFromApi:
Youre building systems that power AI workflows - REST APIs that handle concurrent requests, databases that dont lose data, deployments that dont wake you up at 3 AM. You understand that backend isnt just about making things work; its about making them work reliably.

You wont be writing microservices in a vacuum. Your APIs feed mobile apps, web interfaces, and integrations. Your database decisions matter. Your deployments get reviewed. Your code runs in production, and youre the one who fixes it when it breaks.

Frontend work exists, but youre being hired because the backend is the constraint. Frontend will evolve. The API is permanent.

What You Will Do
  • Design and build REST APIs using Python, Django, and Django REST Framework.
  • Write efficient SQL queries, optimise indexes, and manage relational databases under load.
  • Implement secure authentication, authorisation, and role-based access control.
  • Deploy backend services using Docker and containerised workflows.
  • Build CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment.
  • Debug production issues and ship fixes with minimal ceremony.
  • Collaborate closely with frontend teams on API contracts and data flow.
  • Write clean, testable code and participate in code reviews.
  • Participate in sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives.
What We Are Looking For
  • 1+ years of production experience with Python and Django - non-negotiable.
  • Demonstrable experience building and shipping REST APIs with Django REST Framework.
  • Strong SQL fundamentals: write efficient queries, understand indexes, optimise slow queries.
  • Direct experience deploying production code and debugging issues in production.
  • Git workflow and ability to write clean, reviewable code.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorisation, and basic security patterns.
Good to Have
  • PostgreSQL experience (we use Postgres, not MySQL).
  • Docker containerisation for local development or deployment.
  • Basic AWS knowledge (EC2, RDS, or similar).
  • Experience with relational database design and migrations.
  • Familiarity with asynchronous task queues (Celery or similar).
  • Previous work on multi-user or multi-tenant systems.
  • Experience consuming third-party APIs (payment processors, webhooks, integrations).
  • Redis or caching layer optimisation.
  • GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD pipeline experience.
  • Prior experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.).
What You Will Work On
  • Python (3.8+) with Django and Django REST Framework.
  • PostgreSQL as the primary database, Redis for caching and task queues.
  • React.js on the frontend - you own the API contract, not the UI.
  • AWS infrastructure: EC2, ECS, RDS.
  • Docker for containerised deployments, GitHub Actions for CI/CD.
  • Celery for background job processing.
Why Kuvaka
  • Your code runs in production, not in staging. The APIs you build power healthcare applications, manufacturing workflows, and enterprise platforms - real users, real uptime requirements, real stakes.
  • You work with senior engineers who care about architecture and code quality. You get exposure to AI integration, cloud infrastructure, and working across multiple verticals in one role.
  • Growth is tied to shipping, not time served.

descriptionFromApi:
We Are Synopsys
is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their RD capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You have spent a decade building, verifying, or supporting silicon that ships, and you know the difference between a clean integration and one that costs your customer three months of debug. You understand that a protocol spec is just the starting point. The real work begins when someone tries to configure PCIe Gen5 in a power-constrained automotive SoC or bring up DDR5 on a board that was not quite laid out the way the datasheet suggested.
You have been in the room when things go wrong during tape-out or bring-up, and you are the person who stays calm, asks the right questions, and finds the path through. You can read Verilog, trace a timing violation back to its root cause, and explain what went wrong to a customer engineer who is three time zones away and under pressure. You do not need perfect documentation to move forward. You work with what you have, fill in the gaps, and keep the project on track.
At Synopsys, you will work directly with customers integrating our Interface IP into their most critical designs. The problems are real, the stakes are high, and the work you do will directly determine whether their silicon works on the first pass.
What You'll Be Doing
  • Serve as the technical point of contact for customers integrating Synopsys Interface IP, including Ethernet, PCIe, and DDR, into complex SoC designs
  • Guide customers through IP configuration, feature selection, and integration into their RTL and verification environments
  • Debug critical issues across simulation, synthesis, static timing analysis, and physical design flows using tools like VCS, Design Compiler, and PrimeTime
  • Support silicon and system bring-up activities, working with customers to diagnose and resolve hardware-level issues in lab environments
  • Collaborate with Synopsys RD, product engineering, and field teams to deliver tailored solutions and escalate complex technical problems
  • Stay current with evolving protocol specifications for Ethernet, PCIe, DDR, and emerging standards relevant to automotive, AI, and data center applications
  • Travel occasionally to customer sites for on-site integration support, training, and bring-up assistance
The Impact You Will Have
  • Enable successful first-pass silicon for customers by catching integration issues early and providing expert guidance through tape-out
  • Reduce customer time-to-market by resolving technical blockers quickly and accurately during critical project phases
  • Strengthen customer relationships and drive repeat business by becoming a trusted technical advisor they rely on for complex integrations
  • Influence future IP product roadmaps by feeding real-world customer requirements and pain points back to Synopsys RD teams
  • Expand adoption of Synopsys Interface IP across high-growth markets including automotive, AI accelerators, and hyperscale data centers
  • Contribute to the success of next-generation products that depend on high-speed, low-latency connectivity in increasingly complex system architectures
  • Build internal knowledge and best practices that improve how Synopsys supports customers across the entire applications engineering organization
What You'll Need
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field with focus on VLSI or digital design
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in ASIC/SoC design, verification, or applications engineering with exposure to full tape-out cycles
  • Deep working knowledge of at least one high-speed protocol: Ethernet (10G/25G/50G/100G/400G), PCIe (Gen3/Gen4/Gen5), or DDR (DDR4/DDR5/LPDDR5)
  • Strong RTL coding skills in Verilog or VHDL, with ability to read, debug, and modify customer design code
  • Practical experience with simulation (VCS, ModelSim, Xcelium), synthesis (Design Compiler, Genus), and static timing analysis (PrimeTime, Tempus) in a UNIX/Linux environment
  • Familiarity with clock domain crossing (CDC), reset domain crossing (RDC), lint, DFT, and logical equivalence checking (LEC) is a strong plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences
Who You Are
  • You can take a vague customer problem description, ask three clarifying questions, and walk away with a clear action plan that actually solves the issue
  • You are comfortable working across time zones and cultures, adapting your communication style to meet customers where they are technically and operationally
  • You manage multiple customer engagements at once without dropping threads, keeping stakeholders informed and issues moving toward resolution
  • You know when to dig in and solve a problem yourself and when to pull in specialists from RD, and you do both without ego
  • You are willing to travel occasionally for customer visits, training sessions, and on-site bring-up support when the situation calls for it
  • You stay current with industry trends and protocol evolution because you understand that what you learned five years ago is not enough for what customers are building today
The Team You'll Be Part Of
